name: HadwigerLean.Bootstrap.exists_packing
statement:
theorem exists_packing {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    ∃ (P : Finset (Finset V)) (W R : Set V) (Q : SimpleGraph P),
      Disjoint W R ∧ W ∪ R = Set.univ ∧
      HadwigerLean.IsMinor Q G ∧
      Fintype.card P ≤ Fintype.card V / k ∧
      NoLargeConnectedBipartite (G.induce R) k ∧
      HadwigerLean.chromatic (G.induce W) ≤
        2 * HadwigerLean.chromatic Q

statement:
theorem boundary_extension (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (K L : Set V) (v : V) (hKL : K ⊆ L)
    (hL_v : v ∈ L) (hL_adj : ∀ x, G.Adj v x → x ∈ L)
    (hL_new : ∀ x ∈ L, x ∉ K → x = v ∨ G.Adj v x)
    (C : G.ComponentCompl K) (D : G.ComponentCompl L)
    (hhom : D.hom hKL = C)
    (htouch : ∃ x ∈ (C : Set V), x = v ∨ G.Adj v x) :
    ∃ w ∈ (C : Set V), G.Adj v w ∧
      ∃ a ∈ (D : Set V), G.Adj w a

name: EconCSLib.LinearAlgebra.fmA_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem fmA_inl (A : I → Fin (n+1) → 𝕜) (k : ZeroRows A) (j : Fin n) :
    fmA A (Sum.inl k) j = A k.val j.castSucc

name: EconCSLib.LinearAlgebra.fmA_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem fmA_inr (A : I → Fin (n+1) → 𝕜)
    (p : PosRows A) (q : NegRows A) (j : Fin n) :
    fmA A (Sum.inr (p, q)) j
      = (-A q.val (Fin.last n)) * A p.val j.castSucc
        + A p.val (Fin.last n) * A q.val j.castSucc

name: EconCSLib.LinearAlgebra.fmB_inl

name: EconCSLib.LinearAlgebra.fmB_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem fmB_inr (A : I → Fin (n+1) → 𝕜) (b : I → 𝕜)
    (p : PosRows A) (q : NegRows A) :
    fmB A b (Sum.inr (p, q))
      = (-A q.val (Fin.last n)) * b p.val
        + A p.val (Fin.last n) * b q.val

name: EconCSLib.LinearAlgebra.liftCoeff_inr
statement:
theorem liftCoeff_inr (A : I → Fin (n+1) → 𝕜)
    (p : PosRows A) (q : NegRows A) (i : I) :
    liftCoeff A (Sum.inr (p, q)) i
      = (if p.val = i then -A q.val (Fin.last n) else 0)
        + (if q.val = i then A p.val (Fin.last n) else 0)

name: EconCSLib.LinearAlgebra.farkas_lemma
statement:
theorem farkas_lemma (A : I → Fin n → 𝕜) (b : I → 𝕜) (c : Fin n → 𝕜) (d : 𝕜)
    (hS : IsFeasible A b) :
    (∀ x : Fin n → 𝕜, (∀ i, b i ≤ ∑ j, A i j * x j) → d ≤ ∑ j, c j * x j) ↔
    (∃ u : I → 𝕜, (∀ i, 0 ≤ u i)
      ∧ (∀ j, ∑ i, u i * A i j = c j)
      ∧ d ≤ ∑ i, u i * b i)

name: EconCSLib.LinearProgramming.dualAugA_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualAugA_inl (A : I → Fin n → 𝕜) (i : I) (j : Fin n) :
    dualAugA A (Sum.inl i) j = A i j

name: EconCSLib.LinearProgramming.dualAugA_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualAugA_inr (A : I → Fin n → 𝕜) (j' j : Fin n) :
    dualAugA A (Sum.inr j') j = if j = j' then 1 else 0

name: EconCSLib.LinearProgramming.dualAugB_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualAugB_inl (b : I → 𝕜) (i : I) :
    dualAugB b (Sum.inl i : DualAugRow I n) = b i

name: EconCSLib.LinearProgramming.dualAugB_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualAugB_inr (b : I → 𝕜) (j' : Fin n) :
    dualAugB b (Sum.inr j' : DualAugRow I n) = 0

name: EconCSLib.LinearProgramming.isFeasible_dualAug_iff
statement:
theorem isFeasible_dualAug_iff (A : I → Fin n → 𝕜) (b : I → 𝕜) :

name: EconCSLib.LinearProgramming.lp_strong_duality
statement:
theorem lp_strong_duality (A : I → Fin n → 𝕜) (b : I → 𝕜) (c : Fin n → 𝕜) (d : 𝕜)
    (hP_feas : PrimalFeasible A b)
    (hP_bound : ∀ x : Fin n → 𝕜,
      (∀ i, b i ≤ ∑ j, A i j * x j) → (∀ j, 0 ≤ x j) → d ≤ ∑ j, c j * x j) :
    ∃ u : I → 𝕜, DualFeasible A c u ∧ d ≤ ∑ i, u i * b i

name: EconCSLib.LinearProgramming.lp_weak_duality
statement:
theorem lp_weak_duality (A : I → Fin n → 𝕜) (b : I → 𝕜) (c : Fin n → 𝕜)
    {x : Fin n → 𝕜} (hxA : ∀ i, b i ≤ ∑ j, A i j * x j) (hxnn : ∀ j, 0 ≤ x j)
    {u : I → 𝕜} (hu_du : DualFeasible A c u) :
    ∑ i, u i * b i ≤ ∑ j, c j * x j

name: HadwigerLean.ReedSeymour.exists_shortest_stem_to_gate
statement:
theorem exists_shortest_stem_to_gate (hconn : G.Preconnected)
    {A B : Set V} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    {x : V} (hx : x ∈ B)
    (hgate : ∀ (a : V), a ∈ A → ∀ (b : V), b ∈ B →
      ∀ (p : G.Walk a b), x ∈ p.support) :
    ∃ (a : V) (p : G.Walk a x), a ∈ A ∧ p.IsPath ∧ p.IsChordless ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ p.support → z ∈ A → z = a) ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ p.support → z ∈ B → z = x)

name: HadwigerLean.ReedSeymour.exists_shortest_terminal_connector
statement:
theorem exists_shortest_terminal_connector (hconn : G.Preconnected)
    {A B : Set V} (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty) :
    ∃ (a b : V) (p : G.Walk a b), a ∈ A ∧ b ∈ B ∧
      p.IsPath ∧ p.IsChordless ∧
      (∀ x, x ∈ p.support → x ∈ A → x = a) ∧
      (∀ x, x ∈ p.support → x ∈ B → x = b)

HadwigerLean.ReedSeymour.odd_add_one_of_same_parity

name: HadwigerLean.ReedSeymour.odd_closed_walk_has_equal_parity_edge

theorem odd_closed_walk_has_equal_parity_edge {u : V} (p : G.Walk u u)

name: HadwigerLean.ReedSeymour.odd_cycle_has_distinct_equal_parity_gated_stems
statement:
theorem odd_cycle_has_distinct_equal_parity_gated_stems
    {I : Type*} {N : I → Set V}
    (hmin : IsMinimalConnectedTransversal G N)
    {u : V} (c : G.Walk u u) (hc : c.IsCycle) (hodd : Odd c.length) :
    ∃ x y, s(x, y) ∈ c.edges ∧
      ∃ (sx : GatedCycleStem G N c x) (sy : GatedCycleStem G N c y),
        sx.index ≠ sy.index ∧
        sx.path.length % 2 = sy.path.length % 2

name: HadwigerLean.ReedSeymour.odd_cycle_has_equal_parity_gated_stems
statement:
theorem odd_cycle_has_equal_parity_gated_stems
    {I : Type*} {N : I → Set V}
    (hmin : IsMinimalConnectedTransversal G N)
    {u : V} (c : G.Walk u u) (hc : c.IsCycle) (hodd : Odd c.length) :
    ∃ x y, s(x, y) ∈ c.edges ∧
      ∃ (sx : GatedCycleStem G N c x) (sy : GatedCycleStem G N c y),
        sx.path.length % 2 = sy.path.length % 2

name: HadwigerLean.ReedSeymour.shortest_walk_isChordless

name: HadwigerLean.ReedSeymour.CentralSplit.ofComponents_no_cross
statement:
theorem ofComponents_no_cross (P : ConnectedPartition G I) (i₀ : I)
    (U : Set V) (hconn : (G.induce U).Connected)
    (hsubset : U ⊆ P.block i₀) :
    ∀ c d : (G.induce (P.block i₀ \ U)).ConnectedComponent,
      c ≠ d →
      ¬ ∃ x ∈ (ofComponents P i₀ U hconn hsubset).remainder c,
        ∃ y ∈ (ofComponents P i₀ U hconn hsubset).remainder d,
          G.Adj x y

name: HadwigerLean.ReedSeymour.CentralSplit.ofComponents_partial_and_support
statement:
theorem ofComponents_partial_and_support [Fintype V] [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq I] (P : ConnectedPartition G I) (i₀ : I) (w : V → ℝ)
    (U : Set V)
    [Fintype (G.induce (P.block i₀ \ U)).ConnectedComponent]
    [Fintype (SplitIndex I
      (G.induce (P.block i₀ \ U)).ConnectedComponent i₀)]
    [DecidableEq (SplitIndex I
      (G.induce (P.block i₀ \ U)).ConnectedComponent i₀)] (hsubset : U ⊆ P.block i₀)
    (hU : IsEgg G w U)
    (hP : IsPartialEggDecomposition P w)
    (hnot : ¬ IsEgg G w (P.block i₀))
    (htouch : ∀ k, P.touchingQuotient.Adj i₀ k →
      ∃ x ∈ U, ∃ y ∈ P.block k, G.Adj x y) :
    IsPartialEggDecomposition
      (ofComponents P i₀ U hU.connected hsubset).partition w ∧
    eggSupport P w ⊂
      eggSupport (ofComponents P i₀ U hU.connected hsubset).partition w

name: HadwigerLean.egg_absorbs_bipartite_connector
statement:
theorem egg_absorbs_bipartite_connector

    (hY₁ : IsYolk G w X₁ Y₁) (hY₂ : IsYolk G w X₂ Y₂)

name: HadwigerLean.ReedSeymour.walk_induce_length

statement:
theorem bipartite_connector_fusion_improves [Fintype V] [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq I] [Fintype J]
    [Fintype (FusionIndex I J i₀ i₁)]
    [DecidableEq (FusionIndex I J i₀ i₁)]
    {i₂ : I}
    [Fintype (FusionIndex I J i₀ i₂)]
    [DecidableEq (FusionIndex I J i₀ i₂)]
    (w : V → ℝ) (Y₁ Y₂ A B : Set V)
    (hP : IsPartialEggDecomposition P w)
    (hnot : ¬ IsEgg G w (P.block i₀))
    (hi₂ : i₂ ≠ i₀)
    (h₁ : P.touchingQuotient.Adj i₀ i₁)
    (h₂ : P.touchingQuotient.Adj i₀ i₂)
    (hY₁ : IsYolk G w (P.block i₁) Y₁)
    (hY₂ : IsYolk G w (P.block i₂) Y₂)
    (hU : S.U = A ∪ B)
    (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (hA : G.IsIndepSet A) (hB : G.IsIndepSet B)
    (hconn₁ : (G.induce (P.block i₁ ∪ S.U)).Connected)
    (hconn₂ : (G.induce (P.block i₂ ∪ S.U)).Connected)
    (hcross₁ : ∀ u ∈ Y₁, ∀ v ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj u v)
    (hcross₂ : ∀ u ∈ Y₂, ∀ v ∈ A, ¬ G.Adj u v)
    (hno : ∀ j k, j ≠ k →
      ¬ ∃ x ∈ S.remainder j, ∃ y ∈ S.remainder k, G.Adj x y) :
    (IsPartialEggDecomposition (S.fusionPartition i₁ hi hconn₁) w ∧
      eggSupport P w ⊂ eggSupport (S.fusionPartition i₁ hi hconn₁) w) ∨
    (IsPartialEggDecomposition (S.fusionPartition i₂ hi₂ hconn₂) w ∧
      eggSupport P w ⊂ eggSupport (S.fusionPartition i₂ hi₂ hconn₂) w)

statement:
theorem improve_of_odd_terminal_connector [Fintype V] [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq I]
    (P : ConnectedPartition G I) (i₀ : I) (w : V → ℝ)
    (hP : IsPartialEggDecomposition P w)

    {i₁ i₂ : I}
    (h₁ : P.touchingQuotient.Adj i₀ i₁)

    {a b : V} (p : G.Walk a b)

    (hodd : Odd p.length)

      IsPartialEggDecomposition Q w ∧

theorem odd_chordless_path_bipartition {a b : V}

    ∃ A B : Set V,

name: HadwigerLean.ReedSeymour.CentralSplit.ofComponents_fusion_partial_and_support
statement:
theorem ofComponents_fusion_partial_and_support [Fintype V] [Fintype I]
    [DecidableEq I] (P : ConnectedPartition G I) (i₀ i₁ : I) (w : V → ℝ)
    (U : Set V)
    [Fintype (G.induce (P.block i₀ \ U)).ConnectedComponent]
    [Fintype (FusionIndex I
      (G.induce (P.block i₀ \ U)).ConnectedComponent i₀ i₁)]
    [DecidableEq (FusionIndex I
      (G.induce (P.block i₀ \ U)).ConnectedComponent i₀ i₁)]
    (hUconn : (G.induce U).Connected) (hsubset : U ⊆ P.block i₀)
    (hP : IsPartialEggDecomposition P w)
    (hnot : ¬ IsEgg G w (P.block i₀))
    (hi : i₁ ≠ i₀)
    (h₁ : P.touchingQuotient.Adj i₀ i₁)
    (hnew : IsEgg G w (P.block i₁ ∪ U)) :
    IsPartialEggDecomposition
      ((CentralSplit.ofComponents P i₀ U hUconn hsubset).fusionPartition
        i₁ hi hnew.connected) w ∧
    eggSupport P w ⊂
      eggSupport
        ((CentralSplit.ofComponents P i₀ U hUconn hsubset).fusionPartition
          i₁ hi hnew.connected) w

name: HadwigerLean.Bootstrap.chromatic_separable_of_path_localization
statement:
theorem chromatic_separable_of_path_localization
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (u d k : ℕ) (hu : 0 < u) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hlocal : ∀ (W : Type u) [Fintype W] (H : SimpleGraph W),
      ¬ HadwigerLean.HasCliqueMinor H u →
      Fintype.card W ≤ 2 * u * k ^ 2 →
      HadwigerLean.chromatic H ≤ d * u)
    (hminor : ¬ HadwigerLean.HasCliqueMinor G u)
    (hsmall : NoLargeConnectedBipartite G k)
    (hchi : d * u < HadwigerLean.chromatic G)
    (hpath : PathLocalizationStatement G k
      (HadwigerLean.chromatic G - d * u)) :
    ChromaticSeparable G (d * u)

name: HadwigerLean.pairLoad_pair
statement:
theorem pairLoad_pair (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : StableSet G → ℝ) (u v : V) :

theorem pairProblem_dualValue (G : SimpleGraph V) (δ : ℝ)
    (y : V ⊕ NonedgePair G → ℝ) :

      pairDualValue G δ (fun v => y (Sum.inl v))
        (fun p => y (Sum.inr p))

name: HadwigerLean.pairProblem_dual_iff

theorem pairProblem_dual_iff (G : SimpleGraph V) (δ : ℝ)
    (y : V ⊕ NonedgePair G → ℝ) :
    (pairProblem G δ).DualFeasible y ↔
      IsPairDualFeasible G (fun v => y (Sum.inl v))
        (fun p => y (Sum.inr p))

name: HadwigerLean.pairProblem_primalValue

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.exp_mul_count
statement:
theorem exp_mul_count (S : Finset ι) (t : ℝ) (ω : ι → Bool) :
    Real.exp (t * count S ω) =
      ∏ i ∈ S, (if ω i then Real.exp t else 1)

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.expect_abs_le_sqrt_expect_sq
statement:
theorem expect_abs_le_sqrt_expect_sq (p : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1)
    (X : (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    expect p (fun ω => |X ω|) ≤
      Real.sqrt (expect p (fun ω => (X ω)^2))

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.expect_count
statement:
theorem expect_count (p : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    expect p (count S) = mean p S

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.expect_eventIndicator
statement:
theorem expect_eventIndicator (p : ι → ℝ) (A : Set (ι → Bool)) :
    expect p (eventIndicator A) = prob p A

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.expect_exp_count
statement:
theorem expect_exp_count (p : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) (t : ℝ) :
    expect p (fun ω => Real.exp (t * count S ω)) =
      ∏ i ∈ S, (1 - p i + p i * Real.exp t)

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.expect_exp_count_le
statement:
theorem expect_exp_count_le (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1)
    (S : Finset ι) (t : ℝ) :
    expect p (fun ω => Real.exp (t * count S ω)) ≤
      Real.exp (mean p S * (Real.exp t - 1))

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.expect_mark
statement:
theorem expect_mark (p : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    expect p (fun ω => if ω i then 1 else 0) = p i

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.expect_prod
statement:
theorem expect_prod (p : ι → ℝ) (f : ι → Bool → ℝ) :
    expect p (fun ω => ∏ i, f i (ω i)) =
      ∏ i, (p i * f i true + (1 - p i) * f i false)

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.expect_sum
statement:
theorem expect_sum {κ : Type*} (p : ι → ℝ) (s : Finset κ)
    (X : κ → (ι → Bool) → ℝ) :
    expect p (fun ω => ∑ j ∈ s, X j ω) =
      ∑ j ∈ s, expect p (X j)

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.mean_nonneg
statement:
theorem mean_nonneg (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1)
    (S : Finset ι) : 0 ≤ mean p S

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_all_false
statement:
theorem prob_all_false (p : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    prob p {ω | ∀ i ∈ S, ω i = false} = ∏ i ∈ S, (1 - p i)

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_all_false_exp
statement:
theorem prob_all_false_exp (rate : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    prob (expMarkProbability rate) {ω | ∀ i ∈ S, ω i = false} =
      Real.exp (-(∑ i ∈ S, rate i))

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_all_true
statement:
theorem prob_all_true (p : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) :
    prob p {ω | ∀ i ∈ S, ω i = true} = ∏ i ∈ S, p i

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_biUnion_le
statement:
theorem prob_biUnion_le {κ : Type*} (p : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1)
    (s : Finset κ) (A : κ → Set (ι → Bool)) :
    prob p (⋃ j ∈ s, A j) ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, prob p (A j)

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_count_chernoff
statement:
theorem prob_count_chernoff (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1)
    (S : Finset ι) (t threshold : ℝ) :
    prob p {ω | t * threshold ≤ t * count S ω} ≤
      Real.exp (-t * threshold + mean p S * (Real.exp t - 1))

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_count_chernoff_quadratic
statement:
theorem prob_count_chernoff_quadratic (p : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1) (S : Finset ι)
    (t threshold : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ 1) :
    prob p {ω | t * threshold ≤ t * count S ω} ≤
      Real.exp (-t * threshold + mean p S * (t + t ^ 2))

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_count_ge_chernoff
statement:
theorem prob_count_ge_chernoff (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1)
    (S : Finset ι) (t threshold : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    prob p {ω | threshold ≤ count S ω} ≤
      Real.exp (-t * threshold + mean p S * (Real.exp t - 1))

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_count_ge_mean_add
statement:
theorem prob_count_ge_mean_add (p : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1) (S : Finset ι)
    (D s : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hsD : s ≤ 2 * D)
    (hmean : mean p S ≤ D) :
    prob p {ω | mean p S + s ≤ count S ω} ≤
      Real.exp (-(s ^ 2) / (4 * D))

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_count_ge_of_mean_le_half
statement:
theorem prob_count_ge_of_mean_le_half (p : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1) (S : Finset ι)
    (C : ℝ) (hmean : mean p S ≤ C / 2) :
    prob p {ω | C ≤ count S ω} ≤ Real.exp (-C / 8)

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_count_le_chernoff
statement:
theorem prob_count_le_chernoff (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1)
    (S : Finset ι) (t threshold : ℝ) (ht : t ≤ 0) :
    prob p {ω | count S ω ≤ threshold} ≤
      Real.exp (-t * threshold + mean p S * (Real.exp t - 1))

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_count_le_mean_sub
statement:
theorem prob_count_le_mean_sub (p : ι → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1) (S : Finset ι)
    (D s : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hsD : s ≤ 2 * D)
    (hmean : mean p S ≤ D) :
    prob p {ω | count S ω ≤ mean p S - s} ≤
      Real.exp (-(s ^ 2) / (4 * D))

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_le_expect
statement:
theorem prob_le_expect (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1)
    (A : Set (ι → Bool)) (X : (ι → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ ω, 0 ≤ X ω) (hA : ∀ ω ∈ A, 1 ≤ X ω) :
    prob p A ≤ expect p X

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_mono
statement:
theorem prob_mono (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1)
    {A B : Set (ι → Bool)} (hAB : A ⊆ B) : prob p A ≤ prob p B

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_nonneg
statement:
theorem prob_nonneg (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1)
    (A : Set (ι → Bool)) : 0 ≤ prob p A

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_two_true
statement:
theorem prob_two_true (p : ι → ℝ) {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    prob p {ω | ω i = true ∧ ω j = true} = p i * p j

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_union_le
statement:
theorem prob_union_le (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1)
    (A B : Set (ι → Bool)) :
    prob p (A ∪ B) ≤ prob p A + prob p B

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.prob_univ
statement: theorem prob_univ (p : ι → ℝ) : prob p Set.univ = 1

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.sum_weight
statement: theorem sum_weight (p : ι → ℝ) : (∑ ω : ι → Bool, weight p ω) = 1

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteBernoulli.weight_nonneg
statement:
theorem weight_nonneg (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i ∧ p i ≤ 1)
    (ω : ι → Bool) : 0 ≤ weight p ω

name: HadwigerLean.Theorem2.sampled_union_budget_lt_one
statement:
theorem sampled_union_budget_lt_one
    {r n μ : ℝ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hμ : 0 < μ)
    (hscale : 1000000 * r ^ 4 ≤ μ ^ 4 * n) :
    8 * r ^ 2 * n ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(μ ^ 2 * n / 256)) < 1

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.card_distinct_active_pairs_le_sq
statement:
theorem card_distinct_active_pairs_le_sq (H : IndexedHypergraph W E) :
    ((((H.vertices.product H.vertices).filter
      (fun q : W × W => q.1 ≠ q.2)).card : ℝ)) ≤
      (H.vertices.card : ℝ) ^ 2

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.card_dummy_subsets
statement:
theorem card_dummy_subsets (z j : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin z) => T.card = j)).card =
      Nat.choose z j

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.card_dummy_subsets_two_mem
statement:
theorem card_dummy_subsets_two_mem (z j : ℕ) (d d' : Fin z)
    (hne : d ≠ d') (hj : 2 ≤ j) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun T : Finset (Fin z) =>
      T.card = j ∧ d ∈ T ∧ d' ∈ T)).card =
      Nat.choose (z - 2) (j - 2)

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.card_le_m_mul_fractionalCost
statement:
theorem card_le_m_mul_fractionalCost (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (m : ℕ) (x : StableSet G → ℝ) (hx : ∀ S, 0 ≤ x S)
    (hstable : ∀ S : StableSet G, S.1.card ≤ m)
    (hload : ∀ v, vertexLoad G x v = 1) :
    (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) * fractionalCost G x

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.choose_ge_self_of_pos_lt
statement:
theorem choose_ge_self_of_pos_lt : ∀ z j : ℕ,
    0 < j → j < z → z ≤ Nat.choose z j

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.choose_two_incidence
statement:
theorem choose_two_incidence (z j : ℕ) (hz : 2 ≤ z) (hj : 2 ≤ j) :
    z * (z - 1) * Nat.choose (z - 2) (j - 2) =
      j * (j - 1) * Nat.choose z j

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.chromatic_le_of_MatchingHypothesis
statement:
theorem chromatic_le_of_MatchingHypothesis (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (m p z : ℕ) (ξ γ : ℝ) (x : StableSet G → ℝ)
    (hmatch : MatchingHypothesis G m p z ξ)
    (hpCost : (p : ℝ) ≤ fractionalCost G x + 1)
    (hsize : ξ * ((tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).vertices.card : ℝ) ≤
      γ * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 2)
    (hlarge : 2 ≤ γ * (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) :
    (chromatic G : ℝ) ≤ fractionalCost G x +
      γ * (Fintype.card V : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.colorable_of_MatchingHypothesis
statement:
theorem colorable_of_MatchingHypothesis (G : SimpleGraph V) (m p z : ℕ)
    (ξ : ℝ) (hmatch : MatchingHypothesis G m p z ξ) :
    ∃ k : ℕ,
      G.Colorable (p + k) ∧
        (k : ℝ) ≤ ξ *
          ((tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).vertices.card : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.colorable_of_partial_token
statement:
theorem colorable_of_partial_token (G : SimpleGraph V) {p : ℕ}
    (f : V → Option (Fin p))
    (hproper : ∀ {v w : V}, G.Adj v w → ∀ c : Fin p,
      f v = some c → f w ≠ some c) :
    G.Colorable (p + Fintype.card {v : V // f v = none})

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.colorable_of_tokenDummy_matching
statement:
theorem colorable_of_tokenDummy_matching (G : SimpleGraph V) (m p z : ℕ)
    (M : Finset (TokenDummyLabel G p z))
    (hM : (tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).IsMatching M) :
    G.Colorable
      (p + Fintype.card {v : V // matchingPartialToken M v = none})

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.dummy_mem_tokenDummyEdge
HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.fractionalCost_le_card_of_exact_load
statement:
theorem fractionalCost_le_card_of_exact_load (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (x : StableSet G → ℝ) (hx : ∀ S, 0 ≤ x S)
    (hload : ∀ v, vertexLoad G x v = 1) :
    fractionalCost G x ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.matchingPartialToken_none_iff
statement:
theorem matchingPartialToken_none_iff {p z : ℕ}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (M : Finset (TokenDummyLabel G p z))
    (v : V) :
    matchingPartialToken M v = none ↔
      ∀ e ∈ M, v ∉ e.1.1

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.matchingPartialToken_proper
statement:
theorem matchingPartialToken_proper (G : SimpleGraph V) (m p z : ℕ)
    (M : Finset (TokenDummyLabel G p z))
    (hM : (tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).IsMatching M) :
    ∀ {v w : V}, G.Adj v w → ∀ c : Fin p,
      matchingPartialToken M v = some c →
      matchingPartialToken M w ≠ some c

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.matchingPartialToken_some
statement:
theorem matchingPartialToken_some {p z : ℕ}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} (M : Finset (TokenDummyLabel G p z))
    {v : V} {c : Fin p} (hc : matchingPartialToken M v = some c) :
    ∃ e ∈ M, v ∈ e.1.1 ∧ e.2.1 = c

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.matching_token_injective
statement:
theorem matching_token_injective (G : SimpleGraph V) (m p z : ℕ)
    (M : Finset (TokenDummyLabel G p z))
    (hM : (tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).IsMatching M)
    {e f : TokenDummyLabel G p z} (he : e ∈ M) (hf : f ∈ M)
    (hcolor : e.2.1 = f.2.1) : e = f

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.natCast_finset_sup_le
statement:
theorem natCast_finset_sup_le {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ) (B : ℝ)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (h : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i : ℝ) ≤ B) :
    ((s.sup f : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ B

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.original_mem_tokenDummyEdge
HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.pair_mass_le_of_isPairConstrained
statement:
theorem pair_mass_le_of_isPairConstrained (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (x : StableSet G → ℝ)
    (hx : IsPairConstrainedColoring G δ x)
    (u v : V) (hne : u ≠ v) :
    (∑ S : StableSet G, if u ∈ S.1 ∧ v ∈ S.1 then x S else 0) ≤ δ

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.paper_scale_implies_rounding_scales
statement:
theorem paper_scale_implies_rounding_scales (m : ℕ) (n μ : ℝ)
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hμ1 : μ ≤ 1)
    (hscale : 1000000 * (((m + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4) ≤ μ ^ 4 * n) :
    4 * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ μ * n ∧
      8 * (m : ℝ) ≤ μ * n ∧
      1 ≤ n ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ n

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.pred_ratio_le_ratio
statement:
theorem pred_ratio_le_ratio (m z : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hz : m + 1 ≤ z) :
    (((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((z - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      (m : ℝ) / (z : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.private_color_count_le_uncovered
statement:
theorem private_color_count_le_uncovered (G : SimpleGraph V) (m p z : ℕ)
    (M : Finset (TokenDummyLabel G p z))
    (hM : (tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).IsMatching M) :
    Fintype.card {v : V // matchingPartialToken M v = none} ≤
      (tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).vertices.card -
        ((tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).covered M).card

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.ratio_le_quarter_of_size
statement:
theorem ratio_le_quarter_of_size (m a n μ : ℝ)
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (ha : 0 < a) (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hsize : n ≤ m * a) (hscale : 4 * m ^ 2 ≤ μ * n) :
    m / a ≤ μ / 4

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.sampled_budget_le_paper_budget
statement:
theorem sampled_budget_le_paper_budget (r n μ N P : ℝ)
    (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hμ1 : μ ≤ 1)
    (hN0 : 0 ≤ N) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P)
    (hN : N ≤ r * n + 2) (hP : P ≤ N ^ 2) :
    2 * N * Real.exp (-(μ ^ 2 * n / 256)) +
        P * Real.exp (-(μ * n / 16)) ≤
      8 * r ^ 2 * n ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(μ ^ 2 * n / 256))

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.sampled_covered_eq
statement:
theorem sampled_covered_eq (H : IndexedHypergraph W E)
    (ω : E → Bool) (M : Finset E) :
    (sampledHypergraph H ω).covered M = H.covered M

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.sampled_exact_union_budget_lt_one
statement:
theorem sampled_exact_union_budget_lt_one (H : IndexedHypergraph W E)
    (r : ℕ) (n μ : ℝ)
    (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hμ1 : μ ≤ 1)
    (hN : (H.vertices.card : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) * n + 2)
    (hscale : 1000000 * (r : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤ μ ^ 4 * n) :
    2 * (H.vertices.card : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-((μ * n / 8) ^ 2) / (4 * n)) +
      (((H.vertices.product H.vertices).filter
        (fun q : W × W => q.1 ≠ q.2)).card : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(μ * n / 2) / 8) < 1

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.sampled_matching_lift
statement:
theorem sampled_matching_lift (H : IndexedHypergraph W E)
    (ω : E → Bool) (M : Finset E)
    (hM : (sampledHypergraph H ω).IsMatching M) :
    H.IsMatching M

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.sampled_paper_bounds_imply_matching_hypotheses
statement:
theorem sampled_paper_bounds_imply_matching_hypotheses
    (H : IndexedHypergraph W E) (ω : E → Bool) (n m μ : ℝ)
    (hn : 0 < n) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hμ1 : μ ≤ 1)
    (hverts : H.vertices.Nonempty)
    (hsmall : 8 * m ≤ μ * n)
    (hdegree : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices,
      n - m - μ * n / 8 < ((sampledHypergraph H ω).degree v : ℝ) ∧
        ((sampledHypergraph H ω).degree v : ℝ) < n + μ * n / 8)
    (hcodegree : ∀ u ∈ H.vertices, ∀ v ∈ H.vertices,
      u ≠ v →
        ((sampledHypergraph H ω).codegree u v : ℝ) < μ * n / 2) :
    0 < ((sampledHypergraph H ω).maxDegree : ℝ) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ (sampledHypergraph H ω).vertices,
        (1 - μ) * ((sampledHypergraph H ω).maxDegree : ℝ) ≤
          ((sampledHypergraph H ω).degree v : ℝ)) ∧
      ((sampledHypergraph H ω).maxCodegree : ℝ) ≤
        μ * ((sampledHypergraph H ω).maxDegree : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.sampled_uniform
statement:
theorem sampled_uniform (H : IndexedHypergraph W E) (ω : E → Bool)
    {r : ℕ} (hunif : H.IsUniform r) :
    (sampledHypergraph H ω).IsUniform r

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.scaled_rounded_ratio_between
statement:
theorem scaled_rounded_ratio_between (n m a b : ℝ)
    (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hn : m ≤ n) (hma : n ≤ m * a)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hab : a ≤ b) (hba : b ≤ a + 1) :
    n - m ≤ n * (a / b) ∧ n * (a / b) ≤ n

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.stable_weight_le_one_of_exact_load
statement:
theorem stable_weight_le_one_of_exact_load (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (x : StableSet G → ℝ) (hx : ∀ S, 0 ≤ x S)
    (hload : ∀ v, vertexLoad G x v = 1) (S : StableSet G) :
    x S ≤ 1

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.sum_dummy_mass_eq
statement:
theorem sum_dummy_mass_eq (G : SimpleGraph V) (m z : ℕ)
    (x : StableSet G → ℝ)
    (hstable : ∀ S : StableSet G, S.1.card ≤ m)
    (hload : ∀ v, vertexLoad G x v = 1) :
    (∑ S : StableSet G,
      x S * (((m + 1 - S.1.card : ℕ) : ℝ) / (z : ℝ))) =
      (((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * fractionalCost G x -
        (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) / (z : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.sum_dummy_mem_recip_choose
statement:
theorem sum_dummy_mem_recip_choose (z j : ℕ) (hz : 0 < z)
    (hj : 0 < j) (hjz : j ≤ z) (d : Fin z) :
    (∑ T : Finset (Fin z),
      if T.card = j ∧ d ∈ T then
        (1 : ℝ) / (Nat.choose z j : ℝ) else 0) =
      (j : ℝ) / (z : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.sum_dummy_mem_scaled
statement:
theorem sum_dummy_mem_scaled (z j : ℕ) (hz : 0 < z)
    (hj : 0 < j) (hjz : j ≤ z) (d : Fin z) (a : ℝ) :
    (∑ T : Finset (Fin z),
      if T.card = j ∧ d ∈ T then
        a / (Nat.choose z j : ℝ) else 0) =
      a * ((j : ℝ) / (z : ℝ))

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.sum_dummy_recip_choose
statement:
theorem sum_dummy_recip_choose (z j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ z) :
    (∑ T : Finset (Fin z),
      if T.card = j then (1 : ℝ) / (Nat.choose z j : ℝ) else 0) = 1

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.sum_dummy_two_mem_recip_choose
statement:
theorem sum_dummy_two_mem_recip_choose (z j : ℕ)
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) (hjz : j ≤ z) (d d' : Fin z) (hne : d ≠ d') :
    (∑ T : Finset (Fin z),
      if T.card = j ∧ d ∈ T ∧ d' ∈ T then
        (1 : ℝ) / (Nat.choose z j : ℝ) else 0) =
      ((j : ℝ) * ((j - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) /
        ((z : ℝ) * ((z - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))

name: HadwigerLean.LowCodegreeRounding.sum_dummy_two_mem_scaled
statement:
theorem sum_dummy_two_mem_scaled (z j : ℕ)
    (hj : 2 ≤ j) (hjz : j ≤ z) (d d' : Fin z) (hne : d ≠ d') (a : ℝ) :
    (∑ T : Finset (Fin z),
      if T.card = j ∧ d ∈ T ∧ d' ∈ T then
        a / (Nat.choose z j : ℝ) else 0) =
      a * (((j : ℝ) * ((j - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) /
        ((z : ℝ) * ((z - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))

statement:
theorem tokenDummy_expected_codegree_le_quarter (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (m p z : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hp : 0 < p) (hz : m + 1 ≤ z)
    (x : StableSet G → ℝ)
    (hstable : ∀ S : StableSet G, S.1.card ≤ m)

    (hZlower : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * fractionalCost G x -
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ))
    (μ : ℝ) (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hx : IsPairConstrainedColoring G (μ / 4) x)
    (hscale : 4 * (m : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ μ * (Fintype.card V : ℝ))
    (a b : TokenDummyVertex V p z) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    FiniteBernoulli.mean
      (tokenDummySampleProbability G m p z (Fintype.card V : ℝ) x)
      ((tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).edges.filter
        (fun e => a ∈ (tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).edge e ∧
          b ∈ (tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).edge e)) ≤
      μ * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) / 4

statement:
theorem tokenDummy_expected_degree_between (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (m p z : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hz : m + 1 ≤ z)
    (x : StableSet G → ℝ) (hx : ∀ S, 0 ≤ x S)

    (hload : ∀ v, vertexLoad G x v = 1)
    (hnlarge : m ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hTlower : fractionalCost G x ≤ (p : ℝ))
    (hTupper : (p : ℝ) ≤ fractionalCost G x + 1)
    (hZlower : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * fractionalCost G x -
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ))
    (hZupper : (z : ℝ) ≤
      ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * fractionalCost G x -
        (Fintype.card V : ℝ) + 1)
    (a : TokenDummyVertex V p z) :
    (Fintype.card V : ℝ) - (m : ℝ) ≤
      FiniteBernoulli.mean
        (tokenDummySampleProbability G m p z (Fintype.card V : ℝ) x)
        ((tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).edges.filter
          (fun e => a ∈ (tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).edge e)) ∧
    FiniteBernoulli.mean
        (tokenDummySampleProbability G m p z (Fintype.card V : ℝ) x)
        ((tokenDummyHypergraph G m p z).edges.filter

name: HadwigerLean.exists_boundedDegree_augmentation_from_rounding
statement:
theorem exists_boundedDegree_augmentation_from_rounding
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (δ γ : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hm : independenceNumber G ≤ m) (hm2 : 2 ≤ m)
    (hround : ∀ x : StableSet G → ℝ,
      IsPairConstrainedColoring G δ x →
      (∀ v, vertexLoad G x v = 1) →
      (chromatic G : ℝ) ≤ fractionalCost G x +
        γ * (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) :
    ∃ F : SimpleGraph V,
      F ≤ Gᶜ ∧
      (letI : DecidableRel F.Adj := Classical.decRel F.Adj
       F.maxDegree) ≤
        ⌈(2 / (δ * γ)) /
          (γ / (Nat.choose m 2 : ℝ))⌉₊ ∧
      (chromatic G : ℝ) -
        3 * γ * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤
          fractionalChromaticNumber (G ⊔ F)

name: HadwigerLean.exists_boundedDegree_augmentation_of_cap
statement:
theorem exists_boundedDegree_augmentation_of_cap
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (δ γ : ℝ) (m d : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hm : independenceNumber G ≤ m) (hm2 : 2 ≤ m)
    (hcap :
      (2 / (δ * γ)) /
        (γ / (Nat.choose m 2 : ℝ)) ≤ (d : ℝ))
    (hround : ∀ x : StableSet G → ℝ,
      IsPairConstrainedColoring G δ x →
      (∀ v, vertexLoad G x v = 1) →
      (chromatic G : ℝ) ≤ fractionalCost G x +
        γ * (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) :
    ∃ F : SimpleGraph V,
      F ≤ Gᶜ ∧
      (letI : DecidableRel F.Adj := Classical.decRel F.Adj
       F.maxDegree) ≤ d ∧
      (chromatic G : ℝ) -
        3 * γ * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤
          fractionalChromaticNumber (G ⊔ F)

name: HadwigerLean.heavyVertices_card_le

theorem heavyVertices_card_le (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (δ γ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    {x : StableSet G → ℝ} {a : V → ℝ}

name: HadwigerLean.penaltyGraph_maxDegree_le_ceil
statement:
theorem penaltyGraph_maxDegree_le_ceil (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (b : NonedgePair G → ℝ) (θ cutoff : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ p, 0 ≤ b p) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hcutoff : 0 < cutoff) :

name: HadwigerLean.retainedPairDual_feasible
statement:
theorem retainedPairDual_feasible (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {a : V → ℝ} {b : NonedgePair G → ℝ}
    (hab : IsPairDualFeasible G a b)
    (X : Finset V) (m : ℕ) (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hm : independenceNumber G ≤ m) (hm2 : 2 ≤ m) :
    IsFractionalDualFeasible
      (G ⊔ penaltyGraph G b X (γ / (Nat.choose m 2 : ℝ)))
      (fun v => if v ∈ X then 0 else a v / (1 + γ))

name: HadwigerLean.retainedPairDual_value_bound
statement:
theorem retainedPairDual_value_bound (G : SimpleGraph V)
    {a : V → ℝ} {b : NonedgePair G → ℝ}
    (hab : IsPairDualFeasible G a b)
    (X : Finset V) (m : ℕ) (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hm : independenceNumber G ≤ m) (hm2 : 2 ≤ m) :
    (∑ v : V, a v) - (X.card : ℝ) ≤
      (1 + γ) * fractionalChromaticNumber
        (G ⊔ penaltyGraph G b X (γ / (Nat.choose m 2 : ℝ)))

name: HadwigerLean.selectedIncidentPairs_card_mul_le

theorem selectedIncidentPairs_card_mul_le (G : SimpleGraph V)

name: HadwigerLean.sum_incidentPenalty

name: HadwigerLean.chromatic_bound_of_bounded_induced
statement:
theorem chromatic_bound_of_bounded_induced
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (m : ℕ) (ε B : ℝ)

    (hm : 2 / ε ≤ (m + 1 : ℕ))
    (hsmall : ∀ J : Finset V,
      independenceNumber (G.induce (J : Set V)) ≤ m →
      (chromatic (G.induce (J : Set V)) : ℝ) ≤
        4 * (cliqueMinorNumber (G.induce (J : Set V)) : ℝ) +
          ε * (J.card : ℝ) / 2 + B) :
    (chromatic G : ℝ) ≤

    (hα : independenceNumber G ≤ m ε)

        IsPairConstrainedColoring G (mu ε / 4) x →

        (chromatic G : ℝ) ≤ fractionalCost G x +

    (hrobust : ∀ F : SimpleGraph V,
      F ≤ Gᶜ →
      (letI : DecidableRel F.Adj := Classical.decRel F.Adj
       F.maxDegree) ≤ d ε →
      fractionalChromaticNumber (G ⊔ F) ≤
        4 * (cliqueMinorNumber G : ℝ) +
          (robustAdditive ε : ℝ)) :

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_centered_inducedDegreeCount_sq
statement:
theorem expect_centered_inducedDegreeCount_sq
    (H : IndexedHypergraph V E) (a c : ℝ)
    {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ H.vertices) :
    FiniteBernoulli.expect
      (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
      (fun ω =>
        (inducedDegreeCount H v ω -
          c * FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator
            {ω | vertexSurvives H ω v} ω) ^ 2) =
    FiniteBernoulli.expect
      (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
      (fun ω => (inducedDegreeCount H v ω) ^ 2) -
      2 * c * FiniteBernoulli.expect
        (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
        (inducedDegreeCount H v) +
      c ^ 2 * Real.exp (-a)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_centered_inducedDegreeCount_sq_le
statement:
theorem expect_centered_inducedDegreeCount_sq_le
    (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {r B D : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hunif : H.IsUniform r)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    (hB : H.maxCodegree ≤ B)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hD : 0 < D)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ H.vertices) :
    let c := (H.degree v : ℝ) *
      Real.exp (a - (r : ℝ) * a)
    let k := ((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    let b := (B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ))
    FiniteBernoulli.expect
      (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
      (fun ω =>
        (inducedDegreeCount H v ω -
          c * FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator
            {ω | vertexSurvives H ω v} ω) ^ 2) ≤
      (H.degree v : ℝ) ^ 2 *
        Real.exp (-(k * a)) * (Real.exp (k ^ 2 * b) - 1) +
      ((doublyIntersectingPairs H v).card : ℝ) * Real.exp (-a)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_centered_inducedDegreeCount_sq_le_raw
statement:
theorem expect_centered_inducedDegreeCount_sq_le_raw
    (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {r B D : ℕ} (hunif : H.IsUniform r)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    (hB : H.maxCodegree ≤ B)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hD : 0 < D)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ H.vertices)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    FiniteBernoulli.expect
      (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
      (fun ω =>
        (inducedDegreeCount H v ω -
          c * FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator
            {ω | vertexSurvives H ω v} ω) ^ 2) ≤
        ((incidentEdges H v).card : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          Real.exp
            (-(((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a) +
              (((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                ((B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ)))) +
        ((doublyIntersectingPairs H v).card : ℝ) * Real.exp (-a) -
        2 * c * ((H.degree v : ℝ) * Real.exp (-((r : ℝ) * a))) +
        c ^ 2 * Real.exp (-a)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_inducedDegreeCount_ge
statement:
theorem expect_inducedDegreeCount_ge (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {r D : ℕ} (hunif : H.IsUniform r)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hD : 0 < D) (v : V) :
    (H.degree v : ℝ) * Real.exp (-((r : ℝ) * a)) ≤
      FiniteBernoulli.expect
        (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
        (inducedDegreeCount H v)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_inducedDegreeCount_le
statement:
theorem expect_inducedDegreeCount_le (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {r D B : ℕ} (hunif : H.IsUniform r)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    (hcodeg :
      ∀ u ∈ H.vertices, ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, u ≠ v →
        H.codegree u v ≤ B)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hD : 0 < D) (v : V) :
    FiniteBernoulli.expect
        (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
        (inducedDegreeCount H v) ≤
      (H.degree v : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(r : ℝ) * a +
          (r : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ))))

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_inducedDegreeCount_sq
statement:
theorem expect_inducedDegreeCount_sq (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    (a : ℝ) (D : ℕ) (v : V) :
    FiniteBernoulli.expect
      (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
      (fun ω => (inducedDegreeCount H v ω) ^ 2) =
        (H.edges.filter (fun e => v ∈ H.edge e)).sum (fun e =>
          (H.edges.filter (fun f => v ∈ H.edge f)).sum (fun f =>
            FiniteBernoulli.prob
              (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
              {ω | setSurvives H ω (H.edge e ∪ H.edge f)}))

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_inducedDegreeCount_sq_le
statement:
theorem expect_inducedDegreeCount_sq_le (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {r B D : ℕ} (hunif : H.IsUniform r)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    (hB : H.maxCodegree ≤ B)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hD : 0 < D)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ H.vertices) :
    FiniteBernoulli.expect
      (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
      (fun ω => (inducedDegreeCount H v ω) ^ 2) ≤
        (D : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          Real.exp
            (-(((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a) +
              (((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                ((B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ)))) +
        ((B * (r * D) : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.exp (-a)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_inducedDegreeCount_sq_le_raw
statement:
theorem expect_inducedDegreeCount_sq_le_raw (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {r B D : ℕ} (hunif : H.IsUniform r)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    (hcodeg :
      ∀ u ∈ H.vertices, ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, u ≠ v →
        H.codegree u v ≤ B)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hD : 0 < D) (v : V) :
    FiniteBernoulli.expect
      (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
      (fun ω => (inducedDegreeCount H v ω) ^ 2) ≤
        ((incidentEdges H v).card : ℝ) ^ 2 *
          Real.exp
            (-(((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a) +
              (((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
                ((B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ)))) +
        ((doublyIntersectingPairs H v).card : ℝ) * Real.exp (-a)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_inducedEdgeCount_ge
statement:
theorem expect_inducedEdgeCount_ge (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {r D : ℕ} (hunif : H.IsUniform r)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hD : 0 < D) :
    (H.edges.card : ℝ) * Real.exp (-((r : ℝ) * a)) ≤
      FiniteBernoulli.expect
        (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
        (inducedEdgeCount H)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_induced_degreeExcess_le
statement:
theorem expect_induced_degreeExcess_le (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {r B D Dnext : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hunif : H.IsUniform r)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    (hB : H.maxCodegree ≤ B)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hsmall :
      (((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
        ((B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ))) ≤ 1)
    (hthreshold :
      (D : ℝ) * Real.exp (a - (r : ℝ) * a) ≤
        (Dnext : ℝ) + 1) :
    let k := ((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    let b := (B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ))
    FiniteBernoulli.expect
      (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
      (fun ω =>
        (((H.induce (survivingVertices H ω)).degreeExcess Dnext : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤
      (H.vertices.card : ℝ) *
        (Real.sqrt
          ((D : ℝ) ^ 2 * (2 * (k ^ 2 * b)) +
            ((B * (r * D) : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
          Real.exp (-a))

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_markedPairCount
statement:
theorem expect_markedPairCount (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    (a : ℝ) (D : ℕ) :
    FiniteBernoulli.expect
      (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
      (markedPairCount H) =
    (intersectingPairs H).sum (fun p =>
      FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D) (Sum.inl p.1) *
      FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D) (Sum.inl p.2))

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_markedPairCount_le
statement:
theorem expect_markedPairCount_le (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D) :
    FiniteBernoulli.expect
      (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
      (markedPairCount H) ≤
        (intersectingPairs H).card * (a / (D : ℝ)) ^ 2

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_privateMarkCount
statement:
theorem expect_privateMarkCount (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    (a : ℝ) (D : ℕ) :
    FiniteBernoulli.expect
        (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))

        FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D) (Sum.inr v))

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_privateMarkCount_le
statement:
theorem expect_privateMarkCount_le (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    (a : ℝ) {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)

    FiniteBernoulli.expect
        (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))

      (a / (D : ℝ)) * (H.degreeDeficit D : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_survivingVertices_card
statement:
theorem expect_survivingVertices_card (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    (a : ℝ) {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_survivorCount

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.expect_vertex_degreeExcess_le
statement:
theorem expect_vertex_degreeExcess_le (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {r B D Dnext : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hunif : H.IsUniform r)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    (hB : H.maxCodegree ≤ B)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hsmall :
      (((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
        ((B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ))) ≤ 1)
    (hthreshold :
      (D : ℝ) * Real.exp (a - (r : ℝ) * a) ≤
        (Dnext : ℝ) + 1)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ H.vertices) :
    let _ := (H.degree v : ℝ) *
      Real.exp (a - (r : ℝ) * a)
    let k := ((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    let b := (B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ))
    FiniteBernoulli.expect
      (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
      (fun ω =>
        (((H.induce (survivingVertices H ω)).degree v - Dnext : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator
            {ω | vertexSurvives H ω v} ω) ≤
      Real.sqrt
        ((D : ℝ) ^ 2 * (2 * (k ^ 2 * b)) +
          ((B * (r * D) : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
        Real.exp (-a)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.floor_decay_bounds
statement:
theorem floor_decay_bounds
    {r D Dnext : ℕ} {a : ℝ}
    (hr : 2 ≤ r) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (har : (r : ℝ) * a ≤ 1 / 100)
    (had : 4 ≤ a * (D : ℝ))
    (hfloor : Real.exp ((1 - (r : ℝ)) * a) * (D : ℝ) <
      (Dnext : ℝ) + 1) :
    (D : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (Dnext : ℝ) ∧
      (D : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(r : ℝ) * a) ≤ (Dnext : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.indicator_setSurvives_mul
statement:
theorem indicator_setSurvives_mul (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    (ω : E ⊕ V → Bool) (U W : Finset V) :
    FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator
        {ω | setSurvives H ω U} ω *
      FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator
        {ω | setSurvives H ω W} ω =
      FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator
        {ω | setSurvives H ω (U ∪ W)} ω

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.inducedDegreeCount_eq_degree
statement:
theorem inducedDegreeCount_eq_degree (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)

      (((H.induce (survivingVertices H ω)).degree v : ℝ))

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.inducedDegreeCount_mul_vertexIndicator
statement:
theorem inducedDegreeCount_mul_vertexIndicator
    (H : IndexedHypergraph V E) (v : V) (ω : E ⊕ V → Bool) :
    inducedDegreeCount H v ω *
      FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator
        {ω | vertexSurvives H ω v} ω =

theorem inducedDegreeCount_zero_of_not_vertexSurvives

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.induced_degreeExcess_eq_indicator_sum
statement:
theorem induced_degreeExcess_eq_indicator_sum
    (H : IndexedHypergraph V E) (Dnext : ℕ)
    (ω : E ⊕ V → Bool) :
    (((H.induce (survivingVertices H ω)).degreeExcess Dnext : ℕ) : ℝ) =
      H.vertices.sum (fun v =>
        ((((H.induce (survivingVertices H ω)).degree v - Dnext : ℕ) : ℝ)) *
          FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator
            {ω | vertexSurvives H ω v} ω)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.initial_potential_budget
statement:
theorem initial_potential_budget
    (T : ℕ) (N z₀ q δ a β L μ ξ : ℝ)
    (hN : 0 ≤ N) (hμ : 0 ≤ μ)
    (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hqT : q ^ T ≤ ξ / 4)
    (hError : δ * a * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 + β * (T : ℝ) ≤ ξ / 2)
    (hDeficit : z₀ ≤ μ * N)
    (haT : a * (T : ℝ) ≤ 2 * L)
    (hInitial : 2 * L * μ ≤ ξ / 4) :
    Theorem2.lossPotentialA q δ a β T 0 * N +
      Theorem2.lossPotentialB a T 0 * z₀ ≤ ξ * N

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.markProbability_bounds
statement:
theorem markProbability_bounds (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    (i : E ⊕ V) :
    0 ≤ FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D) i ∧

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.matchingSchedule_of_degree_bounds
statement:
theorem matchingSchedule_of_degree_bounds
    {r B T : ℕ} {D : ℕ → ℕ} {a δ b : ℝ}
    (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hb1 : b ≤ 1)
    (hsmallBase :
      (((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) * a * b ≤ 1)
    (hdelta : 8 * (r : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt b ≤ δ)
    (hDpos : ∀ i ≤ T, 0 < D i)
    (hRatio : ∀ i < T, (B : ℝ) / (D i : ℝ) ≤ b)
    (hHalf : ∀ i < T, (D i : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (D (i + 1) : ℝ))
    (hThreshold : ∀ i < T,
      (D i : ℝ) * Real.exp (a - (r : ℝ) * a) ≤
        (D (i + 1) : ℝ) + 1)
    (hScale : ∀ i < T,
      (D (i + 1) : ℝ) * Real.exp (-a) ≤
        (D i : ℝ) * Real.exp (-((r : ℝ) * a)))
    (hLower : ∀ i < T,
      (D i : ℝ) * Real.exp (-((r : ℝ) * a)) ≤ D (i + 1)) :
    MatchingSchedule r B T D a δ

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.matchingSchedule_of_floor_bounds
statement:
theorem matchingSchedule_of_floor_bounds
    {r B T : ℕ} {D : ℕ → ℕ} {a δ b : ℝ}
    (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (har : (r : ℝ) * a ≤ 1 / 100)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hb1 : b ≤ 1)
    (hsmallBase :
      (((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) * a * b ≤ 1)
    (hdelta : 8 * (r : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt b ≤ δ)
    (hDpos : ∀ i ≤ T, 0 < D i)
    (hRatio : ∀ i < T, (B : ℝ) / (D i : ℝ) ≤ b)
    (haD : ∀ i < T, 4 ≤ a * (D i : ℝ))
    (hFloor : ∀ i < T,
      Real.exp ((1 - (r : ℝ)) * a) * (D i : ℝ) <
        (D (i + 1) : ℝ) + 1)
    (hScale : ∀ i < T,
      (D (i + 1) : ℝ) * Real.exp (-a) ≤
        (D i : ℝ) * Real.exp (-((r : ℝ) * a))) :
    MatchingSchedule r B T D a δ

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.normalized_degreeDeficit_le
statement:
theorem normalized_degreeDeficit_le
    (H : IndexedHypergraph V E) {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    {μ : ℝ}
    (hmin : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices,
      (1 - μ) * (D : ℝ) ≤ (H.degree v : ℝ)) :
    (H.degreeDeficit D : ℝ) / (D : ℝ) ≤
      μ * (H.vertices.card : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.one_round_error_le_eight
statement:
theorem one_round_error_le_eight
    {r B D Dnext : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hD : 0 < D)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hb1 : b ≤ 1)
    (hratio : (B : ℝ) / (D : ℝ) ≤ b)
    (hhalf : (D : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (Dnext : ℝ)) :
    (r : ℝ) *
      (Real.sqrt
        ((D : ℝ) ^ 2 *
            (2 * ((((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
              ((B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ))))) +
          ((B * (r * D) : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
        Real.exp (-a)) ≤
      8 * (r : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.sqrt b * (Dnext : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.privateMarkCount_eq_card
statement:
theorem privateMarkCount_eq_card (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    (ω : E ⊕ V → Bool) :
    privateMarkCount H ω = ((privateMarkedVertices H ω).card : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.prob_good_incident_pair_le
statement:
theorem prob_good_incident_pair_le (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {r B D : ℕ} (hunif : H.IsUniform r)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    (hcodeg :
      ∀ u ∈ H.vertices, ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, u ≠ v →
        H.codegree u v ≤ B)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hD : 0 < D)
    {v : V} {e f : E}
    (he : e ∈ incidentEdges H v) (hf : f ∈ incidentEdges H v)
    (hgood : (e, f) ∉ doublyIntersectingPairs H v) :
    FiniteBernoulli.prob
        (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
        {ω | setSurvives H ω (H.edge e ∪ H.edge f)} ≤
      Real.exp
        (-(((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * a) +
          (((2 * r - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) *
            ((B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ))))

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.prob_incident_pair_le_vertex
statement:
theorem prob_incident_pair_le_vertex (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    {v : V} {e f : E} (he : e ∈ incidentEdges H v) :
    FiniteBernoulli.prob
        (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
        {ω | setSurvives H ω (H.edge e ∪ H.edge f)} ≤
      Real.exp (-a)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.prob_setSurvives
statement:
theorem prob_setSurvives (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    (a : ℝ) (D : ℕ) (U : Finset V) :
    FiniteBernoulli.prob
      (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
      {ω | setSurvives H ω U} =
        Real.exp (-(setLabels H U).sum (rate H a D))

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.prob_setSurvives_ge
statement:
theorem prob_setSurvives_ge (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    {U : Finset V} (hU : U ⊆ H.vertices) :
    Real.exp (-((U.card : ℝ) * a)) ≤
      FiniteBernoulli.prob
        (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
        {ω | setSurvives H ω U}

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.prob_setSurvives_le
statement:
theorem prob_setSurvives_le (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    {B : ℕ} (hcodeg :
      ∀ u ∈ H.vertices, ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, u ≠ v →
        H.codegree u v ≤ B)
    {U : Finset V} (hU : U ⊆ H.vertices) :
    FiniteBernoulli.prob
        (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))
        {ω | setSurvives H ω U} ≤
      Real.exp
        (-((U.card : ℝ) * a) +
          (U.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ))))

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.prob_vertexSurvives
statement:
theorem prob_vertexSurvives (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    (a : ℝ) {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ H.vertices) :
    FiniteBernoulli.prob
        (FiniteBernoulli.expMarkProbability (rate H a D))

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.setSurvives_iff_all_false
statement:
theorem setSurvives_iff_all_false (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.setSurvives_union
statement:
theorem setSurvives_union (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    (ω : E ⊕ V → Bool) (U W : Finset V) :
    setSurvives H ω (U ∪ W) ↔
      setSurvives H ω U ∧ setSurvives H ω W

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.sum_privateRate_eq_deficit
statement:
theorem sum_privateRate_eq_deficit (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    (a : ℝ) {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D) :
    H.vertices.sum (fun v => rate H a D (Sum.inr v)) =
      (a / (D : ℝ)) * (H.degreeDeficit D : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.sum_setLabels_rate_le
statement:
theorem sum_setLabels_rate_le (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    {U : Finset V} (hU : U ⊆ H.vertices) :
    (setLabels H U).sum (rate H a D) ≤ (U.card : ℝ) * a

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.sum_setLabels_rate_lower
statement:
theorem sum_setLabels_rate_lower (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hcap : ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, H.degree v ≤ D)
    {B : ℕ} (hcodeg :
      ∀ u ∈ H.vertices, ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, u ≠ v →
        H.codegree u v ≤ B)
    (U : Finset V) (hU : U ⊆ H.vertices) :
    (U.card : ℝ) * a ≤
      (setLabels H U).sum (rate H a D) +
        (U.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ)))

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.sum_vertexLabels_inter_rate
statement:
theorem sum_vertexLabels_inter_rate (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    (a : ℝ) (D : ℕ) {u v : V} (huv : u ≠ v) :
    (vertexLabels H u ∩ vertexLabels H v).sum (rate H a D) =
      (H.codegree u v : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ))

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.sum_vertexLabels_inter_setLabels_le
statement:
theorem sum_vertexLabels_inter_setLabels_le
    (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D)
    (hcap : ∀ u ∈ H.vertices, H.degree u ≤ D)
    {B : ℕ} (hcodeg :
      ∀ u ∈ H.vertices, ∀ v ∈ H.vertices, u ≠ v →
        H.codegree u v ≤ B)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ H.vertices)
    {U : Finset V} (hU : U ⊆ H.vertices) (hvU : v ∉ U) :
    (vertexLabels H v ∩ setLabels H U).sum (rate H a D) ≤
      (U.card : ℝ) * ((B : ℝ) * (a / (D : ℝ)))

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.sum_vertexLabels_rate

    (vertexLabels H v).sum (rate H a D) = a

    (H.covered (R.accepted ∪ N)).card +
      (R.survivors \ H.covered N).card + R.waste.card =

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.union_card_of_good_incident_pair
statement:
theorem union_card_of_good_incident_pair (H : IndexedHypergraph V E)

    {v : V} {e f : E}
    (he : e ∈ incidentEdges H v) (hf : f ∈ incidentEdges H v)
    (hgood : (e, f) ∉ doublyIntersectingPairs H v) :
    (H.edge e ∪ H.edge f).card + 1 = 2 * r

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.vertexIndicator_sq
statement:

    (v : V) (ω : E ⊕ V → Bool) :
    (FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator
      {ω | vertexSurvives H ω v} ω) ^ 2 =
      FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator

statement:

    {u v : V} (huv : u ≠ v) :

name: HadwigerLean.MatchingRound.vertex_degreeExcess_le_abs_centered
statement:
theorem vertex_degreeExcess_le_abs_centered
    (H : IndexedHypergraph V E) (Dnext : ℕ)
    (ω : E ⊕ V → Bool) (v : V) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : c ≤ (Dnext : ℝ) + 1) :
    (((H.induce (survivingVertices H ω)).degree v - Dnext : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator
        {ω | vertexSurvives H ω v} ω ≤
      |inducedDegreeCount H v ω -
        c * FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator
          {ω | vertexSurvives H ω v} ω| +
        FiniteBernoulli.eventIndicator
          {ω | vertexSurvives H ω v} ω

    (hstable : ∀ S : StableSet G, S.1.card ≤ m)
    (hload : ∀ v, vertexLoad G x v = 1)
    (μ : ℝ) (hμ : 0 < μ) (hμ1 : μ ≤ 1)
    (hscale : 1000000 * (((m + 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 4) ≤
      μ ^ 4 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) :
    ∃ p z : ℕ, 0 < p ∧ m + 1 ≤ z ∧
      fractionalCost G x ≤ (p : ℝ) ∧
      (p : ℝ) ≤ fractionalCost G x + 1 ∧

        (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) ∧
      (z : ℝ) ≤
        ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * fractionalCost G x -

    (c : GreedyChoice G D st.matching st.unprocessed w r)
    (hpartner : c.partner = none)
    (hpartition : st.IsProcessPartition)
    (final : WeightedGreedyState V)
    (hprefix : st.processedVertices <+: final.processedVertices)
    (hgraph : st.matching ≤ final.matching)
    {y : V}
    (hlt : final.processedVertices.idxOf c.selected <
      final.processedVertices.idxOf y)
    (hadj : G.Adj c.selected y) :
    (D ⊔ final.matching).edist c.selected y ≤ (r : ℕ∞)

name: HadwigerLean.IndexedMatching.weight_loss_le_of_later_crossings_close
statement:
theorem IndexedMatching.weight_loss_le_of_later_crossings_close
    {V I : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq V]
    (G D : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel D.Adj]
    (M : IndexedMatching G I) (time : V → ℕ)
    (htime : Function.Injective time) (w : V → ℝ)
    (d r m : ℕ) (halpha : independenceNumber G ≤ m)
    (hdegree : ∀ x, D.degree x ≤ d)
    (hweight : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v ∧ w v ≤ 1)
    (horder : ∀ i, w (M.endpoint i true) ≤ w (M.endpoint i false))
    (hclose : ∀ a : ℝ, ∀ i j : I,
      w (M.endpoint i true) ≤ a → a < w (M.endpoint i false) →
      w (M.endpoint j true) ≤ a → a < w (M.endpoint j false) →
      time (M.endpoint i false) < time (M.endpoint j false) →
      G.Adj (M.endpoint i false) (M.endpoint j false) →
      (D ⊔ M.edgeGraph).edist (M.endpoint i false) (M.endpoint j false) ≤
        (r : ℕ∞)) :
    (∑ i : I, |w (M.endpoint i false) - w (M.endpoint i true)|) ≤
      ((m * ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (d + 1) ^ n) + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)

      w (M.endpoint i true) ≤ a → a < w (M.endpoint i false) →

      time (M.endpoint i false) < time (M.endpoint j false) →
      G.Adj (M.endpoint i false) (M.endpoint j false) →
      (D ⊔ M.edgeGraph).edist (M.endpoint i false) (M.endpoint j false) ≤
        (r : ℕ∞))

name: HadwigerLean.matching_bounds_of_greedy_trace
statement:
theorem matching_bounds_of_greedy_trace
    {V I : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq V]
    (G D : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel D.Adj]
    (M : IndexedMatching G I) (X : Finset V)
    (time : V → ℕ) (htime : Function.Injective time)
    (before : V → SimpleGraph V)
    (hbefore : ∀ x, before x ≤ D ⊔ M.edgeGraph)
    (d r m : ℕ) (halpha : independenceNumber G ≤ m)
    (hdegree : ∀ x, D.degree x ≤ d)
    (w : V → ℝ) (hweight : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v ∧ w v ≤ 1)
    (horder : ∀ i, w (M.endpoint i true) ≤ w (M.endpoint i false))
    (hunmatchedIneligible : ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ y ∈ X,
      time x < time y → G.Adj x y →
      (before x).edist x y ≤ (r : ℕ∞))
    (hpartnerMaximal : ∀ i j : I,
      w (M.endpoint i true) < w (M.endpoint i false) →
      time (M.endpoint i false) < time (M.endpoint j false) →
      w (M.endpoint i true) < w (M.endpoint j false) →
      G.Adj (M.endpoint i false) (M.endpoint j false) →
      (before (M.endpoint i false)).edist
        (M.endpoint i false) (M.endpoint j false) ≤ (r : ℕ∞)) :
    X.card ≤
        m * ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (d + 1) ^ n) + 1) ∧
      (∑ i : I,
        |w (M.endpoint i false) - w (M.endpoint i true)|) ≤
        ((m * ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (d + 1) ^ n) + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)

statement:
theorem robust_bound_of_greedy_trace
    (M : IndexedMatching G I) (D : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableRel D.Adj]
    (hD : D ≤ Gᶜ)
    (m d r : ℕ) (halpha : independenceNumber G ≤ m)
    (hdegree : ∀ x, D.degree x ≤ d)
    (hR : 2 * m ≤ r + 1)
    (w : V → ℝ)
    (hw : IsFractionalDualFeasible (G ⊔ D) w)
    (hopt : fractionalDualValue w = fractionalChromaticNumber (G ⊔ D))
    (time : V → ℕ) (htime : Function.Injective time)
    (before : V → SimpleGraph V)
    (hbefore : ∀ x, before x ≤ D ⊔ M.edgeGraph)
    (horder : ∀ i, w (M.endpoint i true) ≤ w (M.endpoint i false))
    (hunmatchedIneligible : ∀ x ∈ M.unmatchedVertices,
      ∀ y ∈ M.unmatchedVertices,
      time x < time y → G.Adj x y →
      (before x).edist x y ≤ (r : ℕ∞))
    (hpartnerMaximal : ∀ i j : I,
      w (M.endpoint i true) < w (M.endpoint i false) →
      time (M.endpoint i false) < time (M.endpoint j false) →
      w (M.endpoint i true) < w (M.endpoint j false) →
      G.Adj (M.endpoint i false) (M.endpoint j false) →
      (before (M.endpoint i false)).edist
        (M.endpoint i false) (M.endpoint j false) ≤ (r : ℕ∞))
    (hshort : ∀ (u : V) (c : (D ⊔ M.edgeGraph).Walk u u),
      c.IsCycle → c.length ≤ r + 1 →
        ∀ e ∈ c.edges, e ∉ M.edgeGraph.edgeSet) :
    fractionalChromaticNumber (G ⊔ D) ≤
      4 * (cliqueMinorNumber G : ℝ) +
        2 * ((m * ((∑ n ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), (d + 1) ^ n) + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)

    (hδ : d ≤ δ₀) (hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ d / 3)
    (hs : 7 ≤ s) :
    (m₀ - b) * Real.exp (-s * (δ₀ - b) / (m₀ - b)) ≤
      (m₀ - d / 3) * Real.exp (-2 * s / 5)

    (hs : 7 ≤ s) :

name: HadwigerLean.FiniteSampling.exists_fixed_size_sample

theorem exists_fixed_size_sample (u : Finset ι)
    (pairs : Finset (Finset ι)) (m : ℕ)
    (hpair : ∀ e ∈ pairs, e ⊆ u ∧ e.card = 2)
    (hm2 : 2 ≤ m) (hmu : m ≤ u.card) :
    ∃ s : Finset ι, s ⊆ u ∧ s.card = m ∧
      (pairs.card : ℝ) * (Nat.choose (u.card - 2) (m - 2) : ℝ) ≤

name: HadwigerLean.exists_dense_neighborhood_minor
statement:
theorem exists_dense_neighborhood_minor
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d)
    (hnonempty : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hdense : d * Fintype.card V ≤ edgeCount G) :
    ∃ (W : Type u) (_ : Fintype W) (H : SimpleGraph W)
      (_ : DecidableEq W) (_ : DecidableRel H.Adj) (v : W),
      IsMinor H G ∧ edgeCount H = d * Fintype.card W ∧
      (∀ w : W, 0 < H.degree w) ∧ H.degree v ≤ 2 * d ∧
      (∀ w : H.neighborSet v,
        d ≤ (H.induce (H.neighborSet v)).degree w)

      (∀ {X : Type u} [Fintype X] (J : SimpleGraph X),
        IsMinor J G → 0 < Fintype.card X → d * Fintype.card X ≤ edgeCount J →
        Fintype.card W + edgeCount H ≤ Fintype.card X + edgeCount J)

      3 ≤ r → 0 < Fintype.card X →

      HasCliqueMinor G r

name: HadwigerLean.hasCliqueMinor_three_of_edges_ge_card

theorem hasCliqueMinor_three_of_edges_ge_card (G : SimpleGraph V)

name: HadwigerLean.small_order_power_le_density_threshold

name: HadwigerLean.card_constrained_words
statement:
theorem card_constrained_words [DecidableEq V] (s : ℕ)
    (allowed : Fin s → Finset V) :
    Fintype.card
      {ω : Fin s → V // ∀ i : Fin s, ω i ∈ allowed i} =
      ∏ i : Fin s, (allowed i).card

name: HadwigerLean.card_filter_sample_words_in
statement:
theorem card_filter_sample_words_in [DecidableEq V] (A : Finset V) (s : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin s → V => sampleRange ω ⊆ A)).card =
      A.card ^ s

name: HadwigerLean.card_first_without_neighbor
statement:
theorem card_first_without_neighbor
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {s : ℕ} (j : Fin s) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin s → V =>
      ∀ i : Fin s, i < j → ¬ G.Adj (ω j) (ω i))).card =
      ∑ v : V,
        (Fintype.card V - G.degree v) ^ (j : ℕ) *
          (Fintype.card V) ^ (s - (j : ℕ) - 1)

name: HadwigerLean.card_fixed_first_event
statement:
theorem card_fixed_first_event
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {s : ℕ} (j : Fin s) (v : V) :
    Fintype.card
      {ω : Fin s → V // ω j = v ∧
        ∀ i : Fin s, i < j → ¬ G.Adj v (ω i)} =
      (Fintype.card V - G.degree v) ^ (j : ℕ) *
        (Fintype.card V) ^ (s - (j : ℕ) - 1)

name: HadwigerLean.card_sample_words_in
statement:
theorem card_sample_words_in [DecidableEq V] (A : Finset V) (s : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card {ω : Fin s → V // sampleRange ω ⊆ A} = A.card ^ s

name: HadwigerLean.card_sample_words_in_some_le_sum_pow
statement:
theorem card_sample_words_in_some_le_sum_pow
    [DecidableEq V] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (J : Finset ι) (A : ι → Finset V) (s : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin s → V =>
      ∃ j ∈ J, sampleRange ω ⊆ A j)).card ≤
      ∑ j ∈ J, (A j).card ^ s

name: HadwigerLean.card_sample_words_undominated
statement:
theorem card_sample_words_undominated
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (v : V) (s : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.filter
      (fun ω : Fin s → V =>
        sampleRange ω ⊆ (G.neighborFinset v)ᶜ)).card =
      (Fintype.card V - G.degree v) ^ s

name: HadwigerLean.clique_branch_budget
statement:
theorem clique_branch_budget (r : ℕ) (hr : 13 ≤ r) :
    3 * r * (Nat.ceil (4 * Real.sqrt (Real.log (r : ℝ))) + 8) ≤
      Nat.floor (30 * (r : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (r : ℝ)))

name: HadwigerLean.clique_branch_old_set_failure_bound
statement:
theorem clique_branch_old_set_failure_bound (r : ℕ) (hr : 13 ≤ r) :
    (r : ℝ) *
      (4 * Real.exp (-(2 : ℝ) *
        (Nat.ceil (4 * Real.sqrt (Real.log (r : ℝ))) : ℝ) / 5)) ^
          (Nat.ceil (4 * Real.sqrt (Real.log (r : ℝ)))) <
      1 / 8

name: HadwigerLean.connected_induce_inducedComponentSet
statement:
theorem connected_induce_inducedComponentSet
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (B : Finset V)
    (c : (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent) :
    (G.induce (inducedComponentSet G B c)).Connected

name: HadwigerLean.degree_induce_of_noncross
statement:
theorem degree_induce_of_noncross
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (C : Finset V)
    (hnocross : ∀ ⦃a b : V⦄, a ∈ C → b ∉ C → ¬ G.Adj a b)

name: HadwigerLean.degree_sum_le_order_add_common_neighbor_card
statement:
theorem degree_sum_le_order_add_common_neighbor_card
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (x y : V) :
    G.degree x + G.degree y ≤ Fintype.card V +

name: HadwigerLean.eight_mul_bad_component_samples_lt
statement:
theorem eight_mul_bad_component_samples_lt
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (s δ : ℕ) (hV : Nonempty V)
    (hmin : ∀ v : V, δ ≤ G.degree v)
    (hratio : 2 * Fintype.card V < 5 * δ) :
    8 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin s → V =>
      4 ≤ Fintype.card
        (G.induce (sampleRange ω : Set V)).ConnectedComponent)).card <
      5 * Fintype.card (Fin s → V)

name: HadwigerLean.eight_mul_bad_old_samples_lt
statement:
theorem eight_mul_bad_old_samples_lt
    [DecidableEq V] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (J : Finset ι) (A : ι → Finset V) (s : ℕ) (α : ℝ)
    (hm : 0 < Fintype.card V) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hA : ∀ j ∈ J, ((A j).card : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * α)
    (hnum : 8 * (J.card : ℝ) * α ^ s < 1) :
    8 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin s → V =>
      ∃ j ∈ J, sampleRange ω ⊆ A j)).card <
      Fintype.card (Fin s → V)

name: HadwigerLean.eight_mul_bad_old_samples_lt_kt
statement:
theorem eight_mul_bad_old_samples_lt_kt
    [DecidableEq V] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 13 ≤ r) (J : Finset ι) (A : ι → Finset V)
    (hJ : J.card ≤ r)
    (hm : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hA : ∀ j ∈ J,
      ((A j).card : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) *
        (4 * Real.exp (-(2 : ℝ) *
          (Nat.ceil (4 * Real.sqrt (Real.log (r : ℝ))) : ℝ) / 5))) :
    8 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω :
        Fin (Nat.ceil (4 * Real.sqrt (Real.log (r : ℝ)))) → V =>
      ∃ j ∈ J, sampleRange ω ⊆ A j)).card <
      Fintype.card
        (Fin (Nat.ceil (4 * Real.sqrt (Real.log (r : ℝ)))) → V)

name: HadwigerLean.exists_connected_dense_core
statement:
theorem exists_connected_dense_core
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (d k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hthree : 3 * k ≤ d)
    (hpositive : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (horderBound : Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * d)
    (hdegree : ∀ v : V, d ≤ G.degree v) :
    ∃ (X : Type u) (_ : Fintype X) (F : SimpleGraph X)
      (_ : DecidableRel F.Adj),
      IsMinor F G ∧ VertexConnected F k ∧
      ((Fintype.card X ≤ 2 * d ∧ ∀ x : X, d ≤ F.degree x) ∨
       (Fintype.card X ≤ d ∧ ∀ x : X, 2 * d < 3 * F.degree x))

name: HadwigerLean.exists_connected_superset_by_component_paths
statement:
theorem exists_connected_superset_by_component_paths
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (hconn : G.Connected) (hdist : ∀ u v : V, G.dist u v ≤ 5)
    (B : Finset V) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (hcomp : Fintype.card (G.induce (B : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ≤ 3) :
    ∃ Q : Finset V, B ⊆ Q ∧ (G.induce (Q : Set V)).Connected ∧
      Q.card ≤ B.card + 8

name: HadwigerLean.exists_dense_connected_core_from_edges

theorem exists_dense_connected_core_from_edges

    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hk : 0 < k) (hthree : 3 * k ≤ d)
    (hnonempty : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hdense : d * Fintype.card V ≤ edgeCount G) :
    ∃ (X : Type u) (_ : Fintype X) (F : SimpleGraph X)
      (_ : DecidableRel F.Adj),
      IsMinor F G ∧ VertexConnected F k ∧
      ((Fintype.card X ≤ 2 * d ∧ ∀ x : X, d ≤ F.degree x) ∨
       (Fintype.card X ≤ d ∧ ∀ x : X, 2 * d < 3 * F.degree x))

name: HadwigerLean.exists_good_sample_of_count_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_good_sample_of_count_bounds
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (J : Finset ι) (A : ι → Finset V)
    (s δ : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (hV : Nonempty V)
    (hmin : ∀ v : V, δ ≤ G.degree v)
    (hratio : 2 * Fintype.card V < 5 * δ)
    (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (hdom : 4 * (∑ ω : Fin s → V, (undominatedCount G ω : ℝ)) ≤
      (Fintype.card (Fin s → V) : ℝ) * θ)
    (hold : 8 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin s → V =>
      ∃ j ∈ J, sampleRange ω ⊆ A j)).card <
      Fintype.card (Fin s → V)) :
    ∃ ω : Fin s → V,
      (undominatedCount G ω : ℝ) ≤ θ ∧
      Fintype.card (G.induce (sampleRange ω : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ≤ 3 ∧
      ∀ j ∈ J, ¬ sampleRange ω ⊆ A j

name: HadwigerLean.exists_outside_three_bad_events
statement:
theorem exists_outside_three_bad_events
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (bad₁ bad₂ bad₃ : Ω → Prop)
    [DecidablePred bad₁] [DecidablePred bad₂] [DecidablePred bad₃]
    (h₁ : 4 * (Finset.univ.filter bad₁).card ≤ Fintype.card Ω)
    (h₂ : 8 * (Finset.univ.filter bad₂).card < 5 * Fintype.card Ω)
    (h₃ : 8 * (Finset.univ.filter bad₃).card < Fintype.card Ω) :
    ∃ ω : Ω, ¬ bad₁ ω ∧ ¬ bad₂ ω ∧ ¬ bad₃ ω

name: HadwigerLean.exists_small_noncross_side_of_not_connected
statement:

    ∃ C : Finset V, C.Nonempty ∧
      (∃ y : V, y ∉ C) ∧

name: HadwigerLean.four_mul_large_value_samples_le

name: HadwigerLean.sampled_component_count_le_firstWithoutNeighborCount

name: HadwigerLean.sampled_component_count_le_first_without_neighbor

name: HadwigerLean.sum_firstWithoutNeighborCount

name: HadwigerLean.sum_firstWithoutNeighborCount_le

name: HadwigerLean.sum_undominatedCount_le
statement:
theorem sum_undominatedCount_le

name: HadwigerLean.sum_undominatedCount_le_exp
statement:
theorem sum_undominatedCount_le_exp

name: HadwigerLean.threshold_mul_bad_card_le_sum

name: HadwigerLean.exists_good_sample_of_endpoint_bound
statement:
theorem exists_good_sample_of_endpoint_bound
    (R : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel R.Adj]
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (J : Finset ι)
    (A : ι → Finset V) (s δ : ℕ) (η : ℝ)
    (hV : Nonempty V) (hδ : δ ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hmin : ∀ v : V, δ ≤ R.degree v)
    (hratio : 2 * Fintype.card V < 5 * δ)
    (hη : 0 < η)
    (hendpoint : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) *
      Real.exp (-(s : ℝ) * (δ : ℝ) / (Fintype.card V : ℝ)) ≤ η)
    (hold : 8 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω : Fin s → V =>
      ∃ j ∈ J, sampleRange ω ⊆ A j)).card <
      Fintype.card (Fin s → V)) :
    ∃ ω : Fin s → V,
      (undominatedCount R ω : ℝ) ≤ 4 * η ∧
      Fintype.card (R.induce (sampleRange ω : Set V)).ConnectedComponent ≤ 3 ∧
      ∀ j ∈ J, ¬ sampleRange ω ⊆ A j

name: HadwigerLean.new_branch_avoid_card_le_undominated
statement:
theorem new_branch_avoid_card_le_undominated
    (F : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel F.Adj]
    (S : Finset (Finset V))
    {s : ℕ}
    (ω : Fin s → ↥((branchFamilyUsed S : Set V)ᶜ))
    (Q : Finset ↥((branchFamilyUsed S : Set V)ᶜ))
    (hBQ : sampleRange ω ⊆ Q) :
    (branchAvoid F (insert (Q.image Subtype.val) S)
      (Q.image Subtype.val)).card ≤
      undominatedCount (F.induce (branchFamilyUsed S : Set V)ᶜ) ω

name: HadwigerLean.residual_bounds_caseI
statement:
theorem residual_bounds_caseI
    (F : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel F.Adj] (d : ℕ) (U : Finset V)
    (horder : Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * d)
    (hdegree : ∀ v : V, d ≤ F.degree v)
    (hb : 3 * U.card < d) :
    (∀ v : ↥((U : Set V)ᶜ),
      d - U.card ≤ (F.induce (U : Set V)ᶜ).degree v) ∧
    2 * Fintype.card ↥((U : Set V)ᶜ) < 5 * (d - U.card)

name: HadwigerLean.residual_bounds_caseII
statement:
theorem residual_bounds_caseII
    (F : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel F.Adj]
    (d δ : ℕ) (U : Finset V)
    (horder : Fintype.card V ≤ d)
    (hdegree : ∀ v : V, δ ≤ F.degree v)
    (hδ : 2 * d < 3 * δ) (hb : 3 * U.card < d) :
    (∀ v : ↥((U : Set V)ᶜ),
      δ - U.card ≤ (F.induce (U : Set V)ᶜ).degree v) ∧
    2 * Fintype.card ↥((U : Set V)ᶜ) < 5 * (δ - U.card)

name: HadwigerLean.residual_endpoint_caseI
statement:
theorem residual_endpoint_caseI
    (F : SimpleGraph V) (d s : ℕ) (U : Finset V)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hmlo : d < Fintype.card V)
    (hmhi : Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * d)
    (hb : 3 * U.card < d) (hs : 7 ≤ s) :
    (Fintype.card ↥((U : Set V)ᶜ) : ℝ) *
      Real.exp (-(s : ℝ) * ((d - U.card : ℕ) : ℝ) /
        (Fintype.card ↥((U : Set V)ᶜ) : ℝ)) ≤
      ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) - (d : ℝ) / 3) *
        Real.exp (-(2 : ℝ) * (s : ℝ) / 5)

name: HadwigerLean.residual_endpoint_caseII
statement:
theorem residual_endpoint_caseII
    (F : SimpleGraph V) (d δ s : ℕ) (U : Finset V)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hmlo : 2 * d < 3 * Fintype.card V)
    (hmhi : Fintype.card V ≤ d)
    (hδ : 2 * d < 3 * δ)
    (hb : 3 * U.card < d) (hs : 7 ≤ s) :
    (Fintype.card ↥((U : Set V)ᶜ) : ℝ) *
      Real.exp (-(s : ℝ) * ((δ - U.card : ℕ) : ℝ) /
        (Fintype.card ↥((U : Set V)ᶜ) : ℝ)) ≤
      ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) - (d : ℝ) / 3) *
        Real.exp (-(2 : ℝ) * (s : ℝ) / 5)

name: HadwigerLean.residual_parameters_of_core_case
statement:
theorem residual_parameters_of_core_case
    (F : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel F.Adj]
    (d s : ℕ) (U : Finset V)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hpositive : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hcase :
      (Fintype.card V ≤ 2 * d ∧ ∀ v : V, d ≤ F.degree v) ∨
      (Fintype.card V ≤ d ∧ ∀ v : V, 2 * d < 3 * F.degree v))
    (hb : 3 * U.card < d) (hs : 7 ≤ s) :
    ∃ δ : ℕ,
      (∀ v : ↥((U : Set V)ᶜ),
        δ ≤ (F.induce (U : Set V)ᶜ).degree v) ∧
      2 * Fintype.card ↥((U : Set V)ᶜ) < 5 * δ ∧
      (Fintype.card ↥((U : Set V)ᶜ) : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(s : ℝ) * (δ : ℝ) /
          (Fintype.card ↥((U : Set V)ᶜ) : ℝ)) ≤
        ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) - (d : ℝ) / 3) *
          Real.exp (-(2 : ℝ) * (s : ℝ) / 5)

name: HadwigerLean.undominatedCount_eq_no_sample_neighbor
statement:
theorem undominatedCount_eq_no_sample_neighbor
    (R : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel R.Adj]
    {s : ℕ} (ω : Fin s → V) :
    undominatedCount R ω =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun v : V =>
        ∀ w ∈ sampleRange ω, ¬ R.Adj v w)).card

name: HadwigerLean.Deduction.cor24_base_chromatic_threshold
statement:
theorem cor24_base_chromatic_threshold
    (T a : ℕ) (hT : 100 ≤ T) (ha : 1 ≤ a)

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.empty_extends_iff_colorable

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.empty_obstructing

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.exists_fresh_color
statement:
theorem exists_fresh_color (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (h : T.Admissible G k)
    (hpalette : 4 * k < Fintype.card C)
    (v : V) (hv : v ∈ T.carrier \ T.precolored) :
    ∃ γ : C, γ ∉ T.forbidden v ∧ γ ∉ T.precolored.image T.color

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.extends_of_colorable_remainder
statement:
theorem extends_of_colorable_remainder (base : C) (k m : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (ha : T.Admissible G k)
    (hshort : ∀ v ∈ T.carrier \ T.precolored,
      (T.forbidden v).card < k)
    (color : V → Fin m)
    (hcolor : ∀ ⦃u v : V⦄,
      u ∈ T.carrier \ T.precolored →
      v ∈ T.carrier \ T.precolored →
      G.Adj u v → color u ≠ color v)
    (hpalette : m + 6 * k ≤ Fintype.card C) :
    ∃ f : V → C, T.Extends G f

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.extends_of_independent_chunks
statement:
theorem extends_of_independent_chunks (base : C) (k : ℕ)
    {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (B : I → Finset V)
    (hproper : T.ProperPrecoloring G)
    (hsub : ∀ i, B i ⊆ T.carrier \ T.precolored)
    (hcover : ∀ v ∈ T.carrier \ T.precolored, ∃ i, v ∈ B i)
    (hunique : ∀ i j v, v ∈ B i → v ∈ B j → i = j)
    (hindep : ∀ i u v, u ∈ B i → v ∈ B i → G.Adj u v → False)
    (hweight : ∀ i, (∑ v ∈ B i, (T.forbidden v).card) ≤ 2 * k)
    (hpalette : Fintype.card I + T.precolored.card + 2 * k ≤ Fintype.card C) :
    ∃ f : V → C, T.Extends G f

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.extends_of_large_lists
statement:
theorem extends_of_large_lists (base : C)
    (hproper : T.ProperPrecoloring G)
    (hlarge : ∀ v ∈ T.carrier \ T.precolored,
      (T.carrier \ T.precolored).card ≤
        ((Finset.univ : Finset C) \
          (T.forbidden v ∪ T.precolored.image T.color)).card) :

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.firstSide_admissible
statement:
theorem firstSide_admissible (X Y Z : Finset V) (k : ℕ)

    (hshort : ∀ v ∈ T.carrier \ T.precolored, (T.forbidden v).card < k)
    (hX : X.card ≤ k) (hdisj : Disjoint Z (X ∪ Y))
    (hSZ : (T.precolored ∩ Z).card ≤ k) :
    (T.firstSide X Y Z).Admissible G k

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.firstSide_degree_le

theorem firstSide_degree_le (X Y Z : Finset V) (k : ℕ)

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.firstSide_extends_restrict

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.firstSide_list_bound
statement:
theorem firstSide_list_bound (X Y Z : Finset V) (k : ℕ)

    (hSZ : (T.precolored ∩ Z).card ≤ k) :
    ∀ v ∈ (T.firstSide X Y Z).carrier \
      (T.firstSide X Y Z).precolored,

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.firstSide_properPrecoloring
statement:
theorem firstSide_properPrecoloring (X Y Z : Finset V)

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.glue_extensions
statement:
theorem glue_extensions (X Y Z : Finset V)
    (hcover : T.carrier = X ∪ Y ∪ Z)
    (hno : ∀ ⦃y z : V⦄, y ∈ Y → z ∈ Z → ¬ G.Adj y z)
    (f₁ f₂ : V → C)
    (h₁ : (T.restrict (X ∪ Y)).Extends G f₁)
    (h₂ : (T.restrict (X ∪ Z)).Extends G f₂)
    (hagree : ∀ x ∈ X, f₁ x = f₂ x) :

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.no_low_weight_separation
statement:
theorem no_low_weight_separation (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hT : T.Admissible G k) (hobs : T.Obstructing G)
    (hshort : ∀ v ∈ T.carrier \ T.precolored,
      (T.forbidden v).card < k)
    (hminimal : ∀ T' : ChromaticTemplate V C,
      T'.carrier.card < T.carrier.card →
      T'.Admissible G k → ∃ f : V → C, T'.Extends G f)
    (X Y Z : Finset V) (hcover : T.carrier = X ∪ Y ∪ Z)
    (hX : X.card < k) (hY : Y.Nonempty) (hZ : Z.Nonempty)
    (hdisjZ : Disjoint Z (X ∪ Y))
    (hdisjY : Disjoint Y (X ∪ Z))
    (hno : ∀ ⦃y z : V⦄, y ∈ Y → z ∈ Z → ¬ G.Adj y z)
    (hlow : k * (T.precolored ∩ Z).card +
      (∑ v ∈ (T.carrier \ T.precolored) ∩ Z,
        (T.forbidden v).card) ≤ k ^ 2) : False

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.no_small_separation
statement:
theorem no_small_separation (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (hT : T.Admissible G k) (hobs : T.Obstructing G)
