      (T.forbidden v).card < k)
    (hminimal : ∀ T' : ChromaticTemplate V C,
      T'.carrier.card < T.carrier.card →
      T'.Admissible G k → ∃ f : V → C, T'.Extends G f)
    (X Y Z : Finset V) (hcover : T.carrier = X ∪ Y ∪ Z)
    (hX : X.card < k) (hY : Y.Nonempty) (hZ : Z.Nonempty)
    (hdisjZ : Disjoint Z (X ∪ Y))
    (hdisjY : Disjoint Y (X ∪ Z))
    (hno : ∀ ⦃y z : V⦄, y ∈ Y → z ∈ Z → ¬ G.Adj y z) :
    False

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.not_both_side_extensions

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.secondSide_admissible
statement:
theorem secondSide_admissible (X Y Z : Finset V) (f : V → C) (k : ℕ)
    (h : T.Admissible G k) (hX : X.card ≤ k)
    (hdisjXZ : Disjoint X Z)
    (hlow : k * (T.precolored ∩ Z).card +
      (∑ v ∈ (T.carrier \ T.precolored) ∩ Z, (T.forbidden v).card) ≤
        k ^ 2)
    (hf : (T.firstSide X Y Z).Extends G f) :
    (T.secondSide X Z f).Admissible G k

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.secondSide_degree_le
statement:
theorem secondSide_degree_le (X Z : Finset V) (f : V → C) (k : ℕ)
    (hX : X.card ≤ k) (hdisjXZ : Disjoint X Z)
    (hlow : k * (T.precolored ∩ Z).card +
      (∑ v ∈ (T.carrier \ T.precolored) ∩ Z, (T.forbidden v).card) ≤

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.secondSide_extends_restrict
statement:
theorem secondSide_extends_restrict (X Y Z : Finset V) (f₁ f₂ : V → C)
    (hX : X ⊆ T.carrier)
    (h₁ : (T.firstSide X Y Z).Extends G f₁)
    (h₂ : (T.secondSide X Z f₁).Extends G f₂) :
    (T.restrict (X ∪ Z)).Extends G f₂ ∧
      ∀ x ∈ X, f₁ x = f₂ x

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.secondSide_list_bound
statement:
theorem secondSide_list_bound (X Z : Finset V) (f : V → C) (k : ℕ)

    ∀ v ∈ (T.secondSide X Z f).carrier \
      (T.secondSide X Z f).precolored,

name: HadwigerLean.ChromaticTemplate.secondSide_properPrecoloring

name: HadwigerLean.WeightedChunkPacking.card_le

name: HadwigerLean.exists_medium_weight_subset
statement:
theorem exists_medium_weight_subset (S : Finset V) (w : V → ℕ) (k : ℕ)
    (hunit : ∀ v ∈ S, w v < k)
    (htotal : k < ∑ v ∈ S, w v) :
    ∃ B : Finset V, B ⊆ S ∧
      k < ∑ v ∈ B, w v ∧ ∑ v ∈ B, w v < 2 * k

name: HadwigerLean.exists_weighted_chunk_packing

theorem exists_weighted_chunk_packing (w : V → ℕ)

name: HadwigerLean.chromatic_bound_of_obstructing_template
statement:
theorem chromatic_bound_of_obstructing_template
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (k n : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (T : ChromaticTemplate V (Fin n))
    (hnonempty : T.carrier.Nonempty)
    (ha : T.Admissible G k) (ho : T.Obstructing G)
    (hshort : ∀ v ∈ T.carrier \ T.precolored,
      (T.forbidden v).card < k) :
    n < chromatic (G.induce (T.carrier : Set V)) + 6 * k

name: HadwigerLean.connected_of_minimal_obstruction
statement:
theorem connected_of_minimal_obstruction
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (k n : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (T : ChromaticTemplate V (Fin n))
    (horder : k < T.carrier.card)
    (ha : T.Admissible G k) (ho : T.Obstructing G)
    (hshort : ∀ v ∈ T.carrier \ T.precolored,
      (T.forbidden v).card < k)
    (hmin : ∀ W : Finset V, W.card < T.carrier.card →
      ¬ HasAdmissibleObstruction G k n W) :
    VertexConnected (G.induce (T.carrier : Set V)) k

name: HadwigerLean.disconnected_partition
statement:
theorem disconnected_partition {W : Type*} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]
    [Nonempty W] (H : SimpleGraph W) (hH : ¬ H.Connected) :
    ∃ Y Z : Finset W,
      Y ∪ Z = Finset.univ ∧ Disjoint Y Z ∧
      Y.Nonempty ∧ Z.Nonempty ∧
      (∀ ⦃y z : W⦄, y ∈ Y → z ∈ Z → ¬ H.Adj y z)

name: HadwigerLean.exists_chromatic_connected_induced
statement:
theorem exists_chromatic_connected_induced
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hχ : 7 * k ≤ chromatic G) :
    ∃ U : Finset V,
      VertexConnected (G.induce (U : Set V)) k ∧
      chromatic G ≤ chromatic (G.induce (U : Set V)) + 6 * k

name: HadwigerLean.exists_large_minimal_obstruction
statement:
theorem exists_large_minimal_obstruction (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hχ : 7 * k ≤ chromatic G) :
    ∃ (U : Finset V) (T : ChromaticTemplate V (Fin (chromatic G - 1))),
      k < U.card ∧
      T.carrier = U ∧ T.Admissible G k ∧ T.Obstructing G ∧
      (∀ W : Finset V, W.card < U.card →
        ¬ HasAdmissibleObstruction G k (chromatic G - 1) W) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ T.carrier \ T.precolored, (T.forbidden v).card < k)

name: HadwigerLean.exists_maximal_precoloring
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_precoloring (G : SimpleGraph V) (k n : ℕ)
    (U : Finset V) (hU : HasAdmissibleObstruction G k n U) :
    ∃ T : ChromaticTemplate V (Fin n),
      T.carrier = U ∧ T.Admissible G k ∧ T.Obstructing G ∧
      ∀ T' : ChromaticTemplate V (Fin n),
        T'.carrier = U → T'.Admissible G k → T'.Obstructing G →
          T'.precolored.card ≤ T.precolored.card

name: HadwigerLean.exists_minimal_obstructing_carrier
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_obstructing_carrier (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hχ : 7 * k ≤ chromatic G) :
    ∃ U : Finset V,
      HasAdmissibleObstruction G k (chromatic G - 1) U ∧

    (∃ u v, G.Adj u v ∧ x = splitOut u ∧ y = splitIn v) ∨

name: HadwigerLean.Linkedness.common_neighbors_ge_of_contraction_mass_failure
statement:
theorem common_neighbors_ge_of_contraction_mass_failure {G : SimpleGraph V}
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] {a b : V} (hab : G.Adj a b)
    (X : Finset V) (hb : b ∉ X) (r : ℕ)
    (hm : MassedPair G (X : Set V) (r : ℝ))
    (hmissing : ∀ x ∈ X, (X.erase x \ G.neighborFinset x).card ≤ 1) :
    let P := edgeContractionPartition G hab
    let Y : Set (EdgeContractionVertex a b) := partitionIndex P '' (X : Set V)
    (edgeIncidenceSetCount (edgeContraction G hab) Yᶜ : ℝ) ≤
      (r : ℝ) * ((Yᶜ).ncard : ℝ) →
      r - 1 ≤ (G.neighborFinset a ∩ G.neighborFinset b).card

name: HadwigerLean.Linkedness.dense_far_shore_induced_global

theorem dense_far_shore_induced_global

    (hdense : α * (Nat.card S.strictRight : ℝ) <
      (edgeIncidenceSetCount G S.strictRight : ℝ)) :
    let T : Set S.right := {u | (u : V) ∈ S.left}
    α * (Nat.card {u : S.right // u ∉ T} : ℝ) <
      (edgeIncidenceSetCount (G.induce S.right) Tᶜ : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.Linkedness.edgeContraction_incidence_drop_outside
statement:
theorem edgeContraction_incidence_drop_outside {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {a b : V} (hab : G.Adj a b)
    (X : Finset V) (ha : a ∉ X) (hb : b ∉ X) :
    let P := edgeContractionPartition G hab
    let Y : Set (EdgeContractionVertex a b) := partitionIndex P '' (X : Set V)
    edgeIncidenceCount (edgeContraction G hab) Y.toFinsetᶜ + 1 +
      (G.neighborFinset a ∩ G.neighborFinset b).card =
        edgeIncidenceCount G Xᶜ

name: HadwigerLean.Linkedness.edgeContraction_incidence_drop_root
statement:
theorem edgeContraction_incidence_drop_root {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {a b : V} (hab : G.Adj a b)
    (X : Finset V) (ha : a ∈ X) (hb : b ∉ X) :
    let P := edgeContractionPartition G hab
    let Y : Set (EdgeContractionVertex a b) := partitionIndex P '' (X : Set V)
    edgeIncidenceCount (edgeContraction G hab) Y.toFinsetᶜ + 1 +
      (G.neighborFinset a ∩ G.neighborFinset b).card +
      ((G.neighborFinset b ∩ X.erase a) \ G.neighborFinset a).card =
        edgeIncidenceCount G Xᶜ

    (hsmall : ∀ S : VertexSeparation G,
      Nat.card S.right < Fintype.card V →
      Nat.card S.separator < Nat.card R →
      MassedPair (G.induce S.right)
        {u : S.right | (u : V) ∈ S.left} α →
      RootedLinked (G.induce S.right) (separationBoundaryFinset S))
    (hex : ∃ S : VertexSeparation G,
      R ⊆ S.left ∧ Nat.card S.separator < Nat.card R ∧
      α * (Nat.card S.strictRight : ℝ) <
        (edgeIncidenceSetCount G S.strictRight : ℝ)) :
    ∃ S : VertexSeparation G,
      R ⊆ S.left ∧ Nat.card S.separator < Nat.card R ∧
      α * (Nat.card S.strictRight : ℝ) <
        (edgeIncidenceSetCount G S.strictRight : ℝ) ∧
      RootedLinked (G.induce S.right) (separationBoundaryFinset S)

name: HadwigerLean.Linkedness.exists_minimal_violating_shore
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_violating_shore
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (R : Set V) (α : ℝ)
    (hex : ∃ S : VertexSeparation G,
      R ⊆ S.left ∧ Nat.card S.separator < Nat.card R ∧
      α * (Nat.card S.strictRight : ℝ) <
        (edgeIncidenceSetCount G S.strictRight : ℝ)) :
    ∃ S : VertexSeparation G,
      R ⊆ S.left ∧ Nat.card S.separator < Nat.card R ∧
      α * (Nat.card S.strictRight : ℝ) <
        (edgeIncidenceSetCount G S.strictRight : ℝ) ∧
      ∀ Q : VertexSeparation G,
        R ⊆ Q.left → Nat.card Q.separator < Nat.card R →
        Q.right ⊆ S.right → (∃ x ∈ S.right, x ∉ Q.right) →

statement:
theorem massed_contraction_separator_shore
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {a b : V} (hab : G.Adj a b)
    (X : Finset V) (α : ℝ)
    (hm : MassedPair G (X : Set V) α)
    (S : VertexSeparation (edgeContraction G hab))
    (hroot : (partitionIndex (edgeContractionPartition G hab) '' (X : Set V)) ⊆ S.left)
    (hsep : Nat.card S.separator <
      Nat.card (partitionIndex (edgeContractionPartition G hab) '' (X : Set V)))
    (hnone : none ∈ S.separator)
    (hdense : α * (Nat.card S.strictRight : ℝ) <
      (edgeIncidenceSetCount (edgeContraction G hab) S.strictRight : ℝ)) :
    let C := edgeContractionPartition G hab
    let T := partitionPullbackSeparation C S
    MassedPair (G.induce T.right)
      {u : T.right | (u : V) ∈ T.left} α

    (S : VertexSeparation (edgeContraction G hab))

name: HadwigerLean.Linkedness.exists_spliced_linkage
statement:
theorem exists_spliced_linkage
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {r n : ℕ}
    (P : IndexedPairs (Fin r) V) (F : IndexedLinkage G P)
    (J Y : Finset V)
    (hfinish : ∀ t, P.finish t ∈ J)
    (hfirst : ∀ t x, x ∈ pathVertexSet (F.path t) →
      x ∈ J → x = P.finish t)
    (hY : ∀ t, P.finish t ∈ Y)
    (slot : Fin n × Fin 2 → Fin r) (hslot : Function.Injective slot)
    (Q : IndexedPairs (Fin n) V)
    (hQstart : ∀ i, Q.start i = P.start (slot (i,0)))
    (hQfinish : ∀ i, Q.finish i = P.start (slot (i,1)))
    (C : IndexedPairs (Fin n) V)
    (hCstart : ∀ i, C.start i = P.finish (slot (i,0)))
    (hCfinish : ∀ i, C.finish i = P.finish (slot (i,1)))
    (I : IndexedLinkage G C)
    (hIinside : ∀ i, pathVertexSet (I.path i) ⊆ (J : Set V))
    (hIavoid : ∀ i x, x ∈ pathVertexSet (I.path i) →
      x ∈ Y → x ∈ C.terminals i) :
    ∃ L : IndexedLinkage G Q,
      InteriorsAvoid L (Finset.univ.image P.start) ∧
      ∀ i, pathVertexSet (L.path i) ⊆
        pathVertexSet (F.path (slot (i,0))) ∪
        pathVertexSet (I.path i) ∪
        pathVertexSet (F.path (slot (i,1)))

theorem reindex_root_target_linkage

    (X : Finset V) (hX : X.card = r)
    {P : IndexedPairs (Fin r) V} (L : IndexedLinkage G P)
    (hAB : SetMenger.IsABLinkage L (Finset.univ.image root) X) :
    ∃ (P' : IndexedPairs (Fin r) V) (L' : IndexedLinkage G P'),
      (∀ i, P'.start i = root i) ∧
      (∀ i, P'.finish i ∈ X) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∃ i, P'.finish i = x)

name: HadwigerLean.root_target_linkage_or_separator
statement:
theorem root_target_linkage_or_separator
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) {r : ℕ}
    (root : Fin r → V) (hroot : Function.Injective root)
    (X : Finset V) (hX : X.card = r) :
    (∃ (P : IndexedPairs (Fin r) V) (L : IndexedLinkage G P),
      (∀ i, P.start i = root i) ∧
      (∀ i, P.finish i ∈ X) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ X, ∃ i, P.finish i = x)) ∨
    ∃ Q : Finset V,
      Q.card < r ∧
      SetMenger.IsABSeparator G (Finset.univ.image root) X Q

theorem outside_occupied_neighbor_card_le_three_mul

    (hP : P.DisjointTerminals)
    (hne : ∀ i, P.start i ≠ P.finish i)
    (hminimal : ∀ D : ShortPartial G P (terminalFinset P),
      D.used.card = C.used.card → C.totalLength ≤ D.totalLength)
    (x : V) (hx : x ∉ C.occupied) :
    (G.neighborFinset x ∩ C.occupied).card ≤ 3 * k

name: HadwigerLean.Linkedness.ShortPartial.residual_degree_eq_outside_neighbors

name: HadwigerLean.Linkedness.ShortPartial.residual_min_degree_ge_five_mul
statement:
theorem residual_min_degree_ge_five_mul

      D.used.card = C.used.card → C.totalLength ≤ D.totalLength)
    (hdeg : ∀ v, 8 * k ≤ G.degree v)
    (v : ↥((C.occupied : Set V)ᶜ)) :

name: HadwigerLean.Linkedness.linked_side_of_nonreachable
statement:

    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (H : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel H.Adj] (k : ℕ)
    (horder : Fintype.card V ≤ 14 * k)
    (hdegree : ∀ x, 5 * k ≤ H.degree x)
    (u v : V) (huv : ¬ H.Reachable u v) :
    ∃ S : Finset V, S.Nonempty ∧ S.card ≤ 7 * k ∧
      KLinked (H.induce (S : Set V)) k

name: HadwigerLean.Linkedness.dense_linked_side_card_ge_two_mul
statement:
theorem dense_linked_side_card_ge_two_mul
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

    (k : ℕ) (S : Finset V) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hdegree : ∀ v : (S : Set V),
      5 * k ≤ (G.induce (S : Set V)).degree v) :
    2 * k ≤ S.card

name: HadwigerLean.Linkedness.dense_linked_side_of_anticomplete_partition
statement:
theorem dense_linked_side_of_anticomplete_partition
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (k : ℕ)
    (horder : Fintype.card V ≤ 14 * k)
    (hdegree : ∀ v, 5 * k ≤ G.degree v)
    (A B : Finset V)
    (hcover : A ∪ B = Finset.univ)
    (hdisjoint : Disjoint A B)
    (hA : A.Nonempty) (hB : B.Nonempty)
    (hnoedge : ∀ x ∈ A, ∀ y ∈ B, ¬ G.Adj x y) :
    ∃ S : Finset V, S.Nonempty ∧ S.card ≤ 7 * k ∧
      (∀ v : (S : Set V), 5 * k ≤ (G.induce (S : Set V)).degree v) ∧
      KLinked (G.induce (S : Set V)) k

name: HadwigerLean.Linkedness.dense_linked_side_of_nonreachable
statement:
theorem dense_linked_side_of_nonreachable
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (H : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel H.Adj] (k : ℕ)
    (horder : Fintype.card V ≤ 14 * k)
    (hdegree : ∀ x, 5 * k ≤ H.degree x)
    (u v : V) (huv : ¬ H.Reachable u v) :
    ∃ S : Finset V, S.Nonempty ∧ 2 * k ≤ S.card ∧ S.card ≤ 7 * k ∧
      (∀ x : (S : Set V), 5 * k ≤ (H.induce (S : Set V)).degree x) ∧
      KLinked (H.induce (S : Set V)) k

name: HadwigerLean.Linkedness.exists_padded_pairs
statement:
theorem exists_padded_pairs
    (k n : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (Q : IndexedPairs (Fin n) V)
    (hQ : Q.DisjointTerminals)
    (hne : ∀ i, Q.start i ≠ Q.finish i)
    (Y : Finset V)
    (hQY : ∀ i, Q.terminals i ⊆ (Y : Set V))
    (hY : Y.card ≤ 2 * k)
    (hV : 2 * k ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ (hn : n ≤ k) (P : IndexedPairs (Fin k) V),
      P.DisjointTerminals ∧
      (∀ i, P.start i ≠ P.finish i) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, P.start (Fin.castLE hn i) = Q.start i) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, P.finish (Fin.castLE hn i) = Q.finish i) ∧
      Y ⊆ terminalFinset P

    (L : IndexedLinkage (torsoGraph G S) P)
    (B : IndexedLinkage (G.induce S.right) (torsoCrossingPairs G S L))
    (hB : InteriorsAvoid B (separationBoundaryFinset S)) :
    ∃ M : IndexedLinkage G
      ⟨(fun i => ((P.start i : S.left) : V)),
       (fun i => ((P.finish i : S.left) : V))⟩,
      ∀ i x, x ∈ pathVertexSet (M.path i) →
        x ∈ Subtype.val '' pathVertexSet (L.path i) ∨
        ∃ hi : TorsoPathHit G S (L.path i),
          x ∈ Subtype.val '' pathVertexSet (B.path ⟨i,hi⟩)

    {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {r : ℕ}
    (root : Fin r → V)
    (M : MinorModel (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin (2 * r)))
      (completeRoots G (Set.range root))) :
    (∀ i : Fin (2 * r),
      Disjoint (M.branch i) (Set.range root) →
        ∃ x : V, M.branch i = {x}) ∨
    ∃ (i : Fin (2 * r)) (a b : V),

      G.Adj a b ∧ a ∉ Set.range root ∧ b ∉ Set.range root

    (X : Finset V) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    (hm : MassedPair G (X : Set V) α)
    (hbad : ¬ UniversalAt G H X)
    (hsame : ∀ D : SimpleGraph V,
      edgeIncidenceSetCount D (X : Set V)ᶜ <
        edgeIncidenceSetCount G (X : Set V)ᶜ →
      MassedPair D (X : Set V) α → UniversalAt D H X)
    (a b : V) (hab : G.Adj a b) (hout : a ∉ X ∨ b ∉ X)
    (hshore : ∀ S : VertexSeparation (G.deleteEdges {s(a,b)}),
      (X : Set V) ⊆ S.left →
      Nat.card S.separator < Nat.card (X : Set V) →
      (edgeIncidenceSetCount (G.deleteEdges {s(a,b)}) S.strictRight : ℝ) ≤
        α * (Nat.card S.strictRight : ℝ)) :
    edgeIncidenceSetCount G (X : Set V)ᶜ =
      Nat.floor (α * ((Xᶜ).card : ℝ)) + 1

    (hnonisolated : ∃ w : V, G.Adj v w)
    (hout : ∀ w : V, G.Adj v w → w ∉ X →
      Nat.floor α ≤ Fintype.card (G.commonNeighbors v w))
    (hroot : ∀ w : V, G.Adj v w → w ∈ X →
      Nat.floor α ≤ Fintype.card (G.commonNeighbors v w) + (X.erase w).card) :
    let D := closedNeighborhoodFinset G v

    (D.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * α + 1 ∧

name: HadwigerLean.exists_minimal_positive_surplus_set
statement:
theorem exists_minimal_positive_surplus_set
    {V : Type u} [DecidableEq V]
    (S : Finset V) (energy : Finset V → ℝ)
    (degree : V → ℝ) (inside : Finset V → V → ℝ)
    (r δ : ℝ) (hr : 2 < r) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hzero : energy ∅ = 0)
    (hdelete : ∀ T ⊆ S, ∀ v ∈ T,
      energy (T.erase v) + inside T v = energy T)
    (hinside : ∀ T ⊆ S, ∀ v ∈ T, inside T v ≤ degree v)
    (hscore : (r - 1) * δ * (S.card : ℝ) +
      (∑ v ∈ S, degree v) < r * energy S) :
    ∃ T : Finset V, T.Nonempty ∧ T ⊆ S ∧
      (∀ v ∈ T, δ ≤ inside T v) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ T, degree v ≤ r * inside T v)

    ∃ T : Finset V, T.Nonempty ∧ T ⊆ S ∧
      (∀ v ∈ T, δ ≤ ((G.neighborFinset v ∩ T).card : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ T, (G.degree v : ℝ) ≤

name: HadwigerLean.local_dense_neighborhood
statement:
theorem local_dense_neighborhood
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (H X S : Finset V) (p : ℕ)
    (hH : H.Nonempty) (hHS : H ⊆ S) (hSX : Disjoint S X)
    (hinc : ∑ v ∈ H, (G.neighborFinset v ∩ S).card ≤
      2 * connectedSetContractionLoss G H +
        (localRPrime G H X S).card)
    (hmin : ∀ v ∈ S, 4 * p ≤ (G.neighborFinset v ∩ S).card)
    (hratio : ∀ v ∈ S, G.degree v ≤
      3 * (G.neighborFinset v ∩ S).card)
    (hloss : connectedSetContractionLoss G H ≤ p * (H.card - 1))
    (hmax : ∀ v ∈ localRPrime G H X S,
      p * H.card < connectedSetContractionLoss G (insert v H))
    (hX : ∀ v ∈ S, 2 * (G.neighborFinset v ∩ X).card < p) :
    p * (localR G H X).card ≤
      24 * edgeCount (G.induce (localR G H X : Set V))

    (G : SimpleGraph V) (r : ℕ) (Z : Finset V)

    (a b τ κ eG eH degree common : ℝ)

    (hcounter : 6400 * τ * Real.sqrt (a * b) + κ * (a + b) < eG)
    (hsmaller : eH ≤ 6400 * τ * Real.sqrt ((a - 1) * (b - 1)) +
      κ * ((a - 1) + (b - 1)))

name: HadwigerLean.edgeCount_eq_sum_degrees_left

theorem edgeCount_eq_sum_degrees_left

    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A B : Finset V) (hG : G.IsBipartiteWith (A : Set V) (B : Set V)) :
    edgeCount G = ∑ v ∈ A, G.degree v

name: HadwigerLean.edgeCount_le_card_mul_card_bipartite
statement:
theorem edgeCount_le_card_mul_card_bipartite
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A B : Finset V) (hG : G.IsBipartiteWith (A : Set V) (B : Set V)) :
    edgeCount G ≤ A.card * B.card

name: HadwigerLean.edgeCount_le_linear_term_of_small_right
statement:
theorem edgeCount_le_linear_term_of_small_right
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A B : Finset V) (hG : G.IsBipartiteWith (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (t : ℕ) (hB : B.card ≤ t - 2) :
    edgeCount G ≤ (t - 2) * (A.card + B.card)

name: HadwigerLean.exists_left_degree_lt_of_edgeCount_lt
statement:
theorem exists_left_degree_lt_of_edgeCount_lt
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A B : Finset V) (hG : G.IsBipartiteWith (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hA : A.Nonempty) (d : ℝ)
    (hedges : (edgeCount G : ℝ) < (A.card : ℝ) * d) :
    ∃ v ∈ A, (G.degree v : ℝ) < d

name: HadwigerLean.kt_scale_ge_order_and_square
statement:
theorem kt_scale_ge_order_and_square (t : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) :
    (t : ℝ) ≤ (t : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (t : ℝ)) ∧
      ((t : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (t : ℝ))) ^ 2 =
        (t : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log (t : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.mass_and_ratio_of_sample_bounds
statement:
theorem mass_and_ratio_of_sample_bounds
    (τ α n s : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hnlow : τ / α ≤ n) (hnup : n ≤ 2 * τ)
    (hs : 1600 * α * τ ≤ s) :
    800 ≤ s / n ∧ 1600 * τ ^ 2 ≤ s * n

name: HadwigerLean.mass_from_exponential_pair_failure
statement:
theorem mass_from_exponential_pair_failure
    (n s : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hfail : 1 ≤ n ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(2 * s / n))) :
    s ≤ n * Real.log n

name: HadwigerLean.near_complete_power_bound_of_exponential_criteria
statement:
theorem near_complete_power_bound_of_exponential_criteria
    (t ℓ : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) (s n : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (h100 : (100 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (s / n))
    (hlog : 3 * Real.log (t : ℝ) ≤
      s * ((ℓ : ℝ) ^ 2) / n) :
    6 * (t : ℝ) *
      (100 * Real.exp (-(2 * s / n))) ^ (ℓ ^ 2) ≤ 1

name: HadwigerLean.near_complete_power_bound_of_mass
statement:
theorem near_complete_power_bound_of_mass
    (t ℓ : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) (n s : ℝ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hblock : n ≤ 18 * (t : ℝ) * (ℓ : ℝ))
    (hratio : 800 ≤ s / n)
    (hmass : 1600 * (t : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log (t : ℝ) ≤ s * n) :
    6 * (t : ℝ) *
      (100 * Real.exp (-(2 * s / n))) ^ (ℓ ^ 2) ≤ 1

name: HadwigerLean.near_complete_power_of_missing_count_bound
statement:
theorem near_complete_power_of_missing_count_bound
    (t n ℓ m : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (s : ℝ)
    (hmissing : (m : ℝ) ≤ (n.choose 2 : ℝ) *
      Real.exp (-(2 * s / (n : ℝ))))
    (hpower : 6 * (t : ℝ) *
      (100 * Real.exp (-(2 * s / (n : ℝ)))) ^ (ℓ ^ 2) ≤ 1) :
    6 * (t : ℝ) *
      (100 * ((m : ℝ) / (n.choose 2 : ℝ))) ^ (ℓ ^ 2) ≤ 1

name: HadwigerLean.near_complete_power_of_sample_failure
statement:
theorem near_complete_power_of_sample_failure
    (t n : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (τ α s : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hα : 1 ≤ α)
    (hτsq : τ ^ 2 = (t : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log (t : ℝ))
    (hnlow : τ / α ≤ (n : ℝ)) (hnup : (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * τ)
    (hs : 1600 * α * τ ≤ s)
    (hfail : 1 ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(2 * s / (n : ℝ)))) :
    9 * t ≤ n ∧
      6 * (t : ℝ) *
        (100 * Real.exp (-(2 * s / (n : ℝ)))) ^ ((n / (9 * t)) ^ 2) ≤ 1

name: HadwigerLean.nine_mul_t_le_of_exponential_failure
statement:
theorem nine_mul_t_le_of_exponential_failure
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) (n s : ℝ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hfail : 1 ≤ n ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(2 * s / n)))
    (hmass : 1600 * (t : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.log (t : ℝ) ≤ s * n) :
    9 * (t : ℝ) ≤ n

name: HadwigerLean.order_le_eighteen_mul_t_mul_floor
statement:
theorem order_le_eighteen_mul_t_mul_floor
    (t n : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) (hn : 9 * t ≤ n) :
    n ≤ 18 * t * (n / (9 * t))

name: HadwigerLean.sample_size_ceiling_bounds
statement:
theorem sample_size_ceiling_bounds
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 2 ≤ t) (τ α : ℝ)
    (hτ : (t : ℝ) ≤ τ) (hα : 1 ≤ α) :
    let n := Nat.ceil (τ / α + (t : ℝ) - 2)
    t - 1 ≤ n ∧ τ / α ≤ (n : ℝ) ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 * τ

name: HadwigerLean.sqrt_double_decrement_lower
statement:
theorem sqrt_double_decrement_lower
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 1 ≤ b) :
    a / (2 * Real.sqrt (a * b)) ≤
      Real.sqrt (a * b) - Real.sqrt ((a - 1) * (b - 1))

name: HadwigerLean.sqrt_product_sub_one_lower
statement:
theorem sqrt_product_sub_one_lower
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    b / (2 * Real.sqrt (a * b)) ≤
      Real.sqrt (a * b) - Real.sqrt ((a - 1) * b)

name: HadwigerLean.common_left_filter_eq_neighbor_inter_erase
statement:
theorem common_left_filter_eq_neighbor_inter_erase
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A B : Finset V)
    (hG : G.IsBipartiteWith (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (v u₁ u₂ : V) (hu₁ : u₁ ∈ B) :
    (A.erase v).filter (fun y => G.Adj y u₁ ∧ G.Adj y u₂) =
      (G.neighborFinset u₁ ∩ G.neighborFinset u₂).erase v

name: HadwigerLean.replaceFinset_card_add_common
statement:
theorem replaceFinset_card_add_common
    (S : Finset V) (u₁ u₂ : V) (hneq : u₁ ≠ u₂) :
    (replaceFinset S u₁ u₂).card +
      (if u₁ ∈ S ∧ u₂ ∈ S then 1 else 0) = S.card

name: HadwigerLean.sum_twoNeighborContraction_left
statement:
theorem sum_twoNeighborContraction_left
    (A B : Finset V) (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (v u₂ : V) (hu₂ : u₂ ∈ B)
    (f : V → ℕ) :
    (∑ y ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun y : twoNeighborContractionSet v u₂ =>
      y.1 ∈ A)), f y.1) = ∑ y ∈ A.erase v, f y

name: HadwigerLean.sum_twoNeighborContraction_right
statement:
theorem sum_twoNeighborContraction_right
    (A B : Finset V) (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (v u₂ : V) (hv : v ∈ A)
    (f : V → ℕ) :
    (∑ y ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun y : twoNeighborContractionSet v u₂ =>
      y.1 ∈ B)), f y.1) = ∑ y ∈ B.erase u₂, f y

name: HadwigerLean.twoNeighborContraction_class_card
statement:
theorem twoNeighborContraction_class_card
    (A B : Finset V) (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (v u₂ : V) (hv : v ∈ A) (hu₂ : u₂ ∈ B) :
    let S := twoNeighborContractionSet v u₂
    let L : Finset S := Finset.univ.filter (fun y => y.1 ∈ A)
    let R : Finset S := Finset.univ.filter (fun y => y.1 ∈ B)
    L.card + 1 = A.card ∧ R.card + 1 = B.card

name: HadwigerLean.twoNeighborContraction_degree_left_add_common
statement:
theorem twoNeighborContraction_degree_left_add_common
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A B : Finset V)
    (hG : G.IsBipartiteWith (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (v u₁ u₂ : V) [DecidableRel (twoNeighborContractionGraph G v u₁ u₂).Adj]
    (hv : v ∈ A) (hu₁ : u₁ ∈ B) (hneq : u₁ ≠ u₂)
    (y : twoNeighborContractionSet v u₂) (hy : y.1 ∈ A) :
    (twoNeighborContractionGraph G v u₁ u₂).degree y +
      (if G.Adj y.1 u₁ ∧ G.Adj y.1 u₂ then 1 else 0) = G.degree y.1

name: HadwigerLean.twoNeighborContraction_edgeCount_add_degree_add_common
statement:
theorem twoNeighborContraction_edgeCount_add_degree_add_common
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A B : Finset V)
    (hG : G.IsBipartiteWith (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (v u₁ u₂ : V) [DecidableRel (twoNeighborContractionGraph G v u₁ u₂).Adj]
    (hv : v ∈ A) (hu₁ : u₁ ∈ B) (hu₂ : u₂ ∈ B)
    (hneq : u₁ ≠ u₂) :
    edgeCount (twoNeighborContractionGraph G v u₁ u₂) + G.degree v +
      ((G.neighborFinset u₁ ∩ G.neighborFinset u₂).erase v).card =
      edgeCount G

name: HadwigerLean.twoNeighborContraction_edgeCount_add_loss
statement:
theorem twoNeighborContraction_edgeCount_add_loss
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A B : Finset V)
    (hG : G.IsBipartiteWith (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (v u₁ u₂ : V) [DecidableRel (twoNeighborContractionGraph G v u₁ u₂).Adj]
    (hv : v ∈ A) (hu₁ : u₁ ∈ B) (hu₂ : u₂ ∈ B)
    (hneq : u₁ ≠ u₂) :
    edgeCount (twoNeighborContractionGraph G v u₁ u₂) +
      ((A.erase v).filter (fun y => G.Adj y u₁ ∧ G.Adj y u₂)).card +
      G.degree v = edgeCount G

name: HadwigerLean.twoNeighborContraction_isBipartiteWith
statement:
theorem twoNeighborContraction_isBipartiteWith
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (A B : Finset V)
    (hG : G.IsBipartiteWith (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (v u₁ u₂ : V) (hu₁ : u₁ ∈ B) (hu₂ : u₂ ∈ B) :
    (twoNeighborContractionGraph G v u₁ u₂).IsBipartiteWith
      {x | x.1 ∈ A} {x | x.1 ∈ B}

name: HadwigerLean.twoNeighborContraction_isMinor
statement:
theorem twoNeighborContraction_isMinor
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (v u₁ u₂ : V)
    (h₁ : G.Adj v u₁) (h₂ : G.Adj v u₂) :
    IsMinor (twoNeighborContractionGraph G v u₁ u₂) G

name: HadwigerLean.twoNeighborContraction_neighborFinset_left
statement:
theorem twoNeighborContraction_neighborFinset_left
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A B : Finset V)
    (hG : G.IsBipartiteWith (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (v u₁ u₂ : V) [DecidableRel (twoNeighborContractionGraph G v u₁ u₂).Adj]
    (hv : v ∈ A) (hu₁ : u₁ ∈ B)
    (hneq : u₁ ≠ u₂)
    (y : twoNeighborContractionSet v u₂) (hy : y.1 ∈ A) :
    ((twoNeighborContractionGraph G v u₁ u₂).neighborFinset y).map
      (.subtype (· ∈ twoNeighborContractionSet v u₂)) =
    replaceFinset (G.neighborFinset y.1) u₁ u₂

name: HadwigerLean.avoidPairChoices_eq_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem avoidPairChoices_eq_of_not_mem
    (A : Finset V) (C : ↥(A : Set V) → Finset V)
    (W : Finset ↥(A : Set V)) (x y : V)
    (w : ↥(A : Set V)) (hw : w ∉ W) :
    avoidPairChoices A C W x y w = C w

name: HadwigerLean.card_avoidPairChoices_add_two
statement:
theorem card_avoidPairChoices_add_two
    (A : Finset V) (C : ↥(A : Set V) → Finset V)
    (W : Finset ↥(A : Set V)) (x y : V) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (w : ↥(A : Set V)) (hw : w ∈ W)
    (hx : x ∈ C w) (hy : y ∈ C w) :
    (avoidPairChoices A C W x y w).card + 2 = (C w).card

name: HadwigerLean.card_starAssignmentFinset
statement:
@[simp] theorem card_starAssignmentFinset
    (A : Finset V) (C : ↥(A : Set V) → Finset V) :
    (starAssignmentFinset A C).card =
      ∏ w : ↥(A : Set V), (C w).card

name: HadwigerLean.card_star_assignments_avoiding_pair_le_exp
statement:
theorem card_star_assignments_avoiding_pair_le_exp
    (A : Finset V) (C : ↥(A : Set V) → Finset V)
    (W : Finset ↥(A : Set V)) (x y : V) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hmax : ∀ w, (C w).card ≤ n)
    (hxyC : ∀ w ∈ W, x ∈ C w ∧ y ∈ C w) :
    ((starAssignmentFinset A C |>.filter (fun f =>
      ∀ w ∈ W, f w ≠ x ∧ f w ≠ y)).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((starAssignmentFinset A C).card : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(2 * (W.card : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)))

name: HadwigerLean.card_star_assignments_avoiding_pair_le_factor
statement:
theorem card_star_assignments_avoiding_pair_le_factor
    (A : Finset V) (C : ↥(A : Set V) → Finset V)
    (W : Finset ↥(A : Set V)) (x y : V) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hmax : ∀ w, (C w).card ≤ n)
    (hxyC : ∀ w ∈ W, x ∈ C w ∧ y ∈ C w) :
    ((starAssignmentFinset A C |>.filter (fun f =>
      ∀ w ∈ W, f w ≠ x ∧ f w ≠ y)).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((starAssignmentFinset A C).card : ℝ) *
        (1 - 2 / (n : ℝ)) ^ W.card

name: HadwigerLean.card_star_assignments_avoiding_pair_le_prod
statement:
theorem card_star_assignments_avoiding_pair_le_prod
    (A : Finset V) (C : ↥(A : Set V) → Finset V)
    (W : Finset ↥(A : Set V)) (x y : V) :
    (starAssignmentFinset A C |>.filter (fun f =>
      ∀ w ∈ W, f w ≠ x ∧ f w ≠ y)).card ≤
      ∏ w : ↥(A : Set V),
        (avoidPairChoices A C W x y w).card

name: HadwigerLean.card_star_assignments_missing_pair_le_exp
statement:
theorem card_star_assignments_missing_pair_le_exp
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A X : Finset V) (x y : ↥(X : Set V)) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (W : Finset ↥(A : Set V))
    (hcommon : ∀ w ∈ W, G.Adj w.1 x.1 ∧ G.Adj w.1 y.1)
    (hn : 2 ≤ X.card) :
    ((starMissingAssignments G A X x y).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((starAssignmentFinset A
        (fun w : ↥(A : Set V) => starNeighborChoices G X w.1)).card : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(2 * (W.card : ℝ) / (X.card : ℝ)))

name: HadwigerLean.card_star_assignments_missing_pair_le_exp_lower
statement:
theorem card_star_assignments_missing_pair_le_exp_lower
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A X : Finset V) (x y : ↥(X : Set V)) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : s ≤ (starCommonNeighbors G A X x y).card)
    (hn : 2 ≤ X.card) :
    ((starMissingAssignments G A X x y).card : ℝ) ≤
      ((starAssignmentFinset A
        (fun w : ↥(A : Set V) => starNeighborChoices G X w.1)).card : ℝ) *
        Real.exp (-(2 * (s : ℝ) / (X.card : ℝ)))

name: HadwigerLean.exists_outcome_with_few_failures
statement:
theorem exists_outcome_with_few_failures
    {Ω E : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    (S : Finset Ω) (T : Finset E) (P : Ω → E → Prop)
    [DecidableRel P] (hS : S.Nonempty) (q : ℝ)
    (hevent : ∀ e ∈ T,
      ((S.filter (fun ω => P ω e)).card : ℝ) ≤ q * (S.card : ℝ)) :
    ∃ ω ∈ S, ((T.filter (P ω)).card : ℝ) ≤ q * (T.card : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.exists_star_assignment_with_few_missing_edges
statement:
theorem exists_star_assignment_with_few_missing_edges
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A X : Finset V) (s : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ X.card)
    (hchoices : ∀ w ∈ A, ∃ x ∈ X, G.Adj w x)
    (hcommon : ∀ x y : ↥(X : Set V), x ≠ y →
      s ≤ (starCommonNeighbors G A X x y).card) :
    ∃ g : ↥(starAssignmentFinset A
      (fun w : ↥(A : Set V) => starNeighborChoices G X w.1)),
      ((starMissingEdges G A X g).card : ℝ) ≤
        ((X.card.choose 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-(2 * (s : ℝ) / (X.card : ℝ)))

name: HadwigerLean.exists_star_contraction_minor_with_few_missing_edges
statement:
theorem exists_star_contraction_minor_with_few_missing_edges
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A X : Finset V) (hAX : Disjoint A X)
    (s : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ X.card)
    (hchoices : ∀ w ∈ A, ∃ x ∈ X, G.Adj w x)
    (hcommon : ∀ x y : ↥(X : Set V), x ≠ y →
      s ≤ (starCommonNeighbors G A X x y).card) :
    ∃ H : SimpleGraph ↥(X : Set V),
      IsMinor H G ∧
      (edgeCount Hᶜ : ℝ) ≤
        ((X.card.choose 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          Real.exp (-(2 * (s : ℝ) / (X.card : ℝ)))

name: HadwigerLean.hasCliqueMinor_of_star_pair_expect_lt_one
statement:
theorem hasCliqueMinor_of_star_pair_expect_lt_one
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A X : Finset V) (hAX : Disjoint A X)
    (v : V) (hvA : v ∉ A) (hvX : v ∉ X)
    (hneighbor : ∀ x ∈ X, G.Adj v x)
    (s t : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ X.card) (ht : t ≤ X.card + 1)
    (hchoices : ∀ w ∈ A, ∃ x ∈ X, G.Adj w x)
    (hcommon : ∀ x y : ↥(X : Set V), x ≠ y →
      s ≤ (starCommonNeighbors G A X x y).card)
    (hsmall : ((X.card.choose 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      Real.exp (-(2 * (s : ℝ) / (X.card : ℝ))) < 1) :
    HasCliqueMinor G t

name: HadwigerLean.hasCliqueMinor_succ_of_complete_star_assignment
statement:
theorem hasCliqueMinor_succ_of_complete_star_assignment
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A X : Finset V) (hAX : Disjoint A X)
    (g : ↥(starAssignmentFinset A
      (fun w : ↥(A : Set V) => starNeighborChoices G X w.1)))
    (v : V) (hvA : v ∉ A) (hvX : v ∉ X)
    (hneighbor : ∀ x ∈ X, G.Adj v x)
    (hcomplete : ∀ x y : ↥(X : Set V), x ≠ y →
      (starContractionGraph G A X
        (starAssignedCenter G A X g)).Adj x y) :
    HasCliqueMinor G (Fintype.card ↥(X : Set V) + 1)

name: HadwigerLean.hasCliqueMinor_succ_of_touched_model
statement:
theorem hasCliqueMinor_succ_of_touched_model
    {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (M : MinorModel (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin n)) G)
    (v : V) (hv : ∀ i, v ∉ M.branch i)
    (htouch : ∀ i, ∃ x ∈ M.branch i, G.Adj v x) :
    HasCliqueMinor G (n + 1)

name: HadwigerLean.mem_starAssignmentFinset
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_starAssignmentFinset
    (A : Finset V) (C : ↥(A : Set V) → Finset V)
    (f : ↥(A : Set V) → V) :
    f ∈ starAssignmentFinset A C ↔ ∀ w, f w ∈ C w

name: HadwigerLean.starAssignedCenter_adj
statement:
theorem starAssignedCenter_adj (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A X : Finset V)
    (g : ↥(starAssignmentFinset A
      (fun w : ↥(A : Set V) => starNeighborChoices G X w.1)))
    (w : ↥(A : Set V)) :
    G.Adj w.1 (starAssignedCenter G A X g w).1

name: HadwigerLean.starAssignment_missing_avoids_common
statement:
theorem starAssignment_missing_avoids_common
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A X : Finset V) (x y : ↥(X : Set V)) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (W : Finset ↥(A : Set V))
    (hcommon : ∀ w ∈ W, G.Adj w.1 x.1 ∧ G.Adj w.1 y.1)
    (g : ↥(starAssignmentFinset A
      (fun w : ↥(A : Set V) => starNeighborChoices G X w.1)))
    (hmiss : ¬ (starContractionGraph G A X
      (starAssignedCenter G A X g)).Adj x y) :
    ∀ w ∈ W, g.1 w ≠ x.1 ∧ g.1 w ≠ y.1

name: HadwigerLean.starContractionGraph_adj_of_common_assignment
statement:
theorem starContractionGraph_adj_of_common_assignment
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (A X : Finset V)
    (f : ↥(A : Set V) → ↥(X : Set V))
    (x y : ↥(X : Set V)) (hxy : x ≠ y)
    (w : ↥(A : Set V))
    (hwx : G.Adj w.1 x.1) (hwy : G.Adj w.1 y.1)
    (hassigned : f w = x ∨ f w = y) :
    (starContractionGraph G A X f).Adj x y

name: HadwigerLean.starContractionGraph_isMinor
statement:
theorem starContractionGraph_isMinor

name: HadwigerLean.bipartite_vertex_deletion_data
statement:
theorem bipartite_vertex_deletion_data
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (A B : Finset V) (hG : G.IsBipartiteWith (A : Set V) (B : Set V))
    (hcover : A ∪ B = Finset.univ) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ A) :
    let S : Set V := ({v} : Set V)ᶜ
    let A' : Finset S := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => (x : V) ∈ A)
    let B' : Finset S := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => (x : V) ∈ B)
    (G.induce S).IsBipartiteWith (A' : Set S) (B' : Set S) ∧
      A'.card + 1 = A.card ∧ B'.card = B.card ∧
      A' ∪ B' = Finset.univ ∧
      edgeCount (G.induce S) + G.degree v = edgeCount G

name: HadwigerLean.common_neighbors_le_sampled_star_common
statement:
theorem common_neighbors_le_sampled_star_common
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]

    (v : V) (hv : v ∈ A) (hX : X ⊆ G.neighborFinset v)
    (x y : ↥(X : Set V)) :
    ((G.neighborFinset x.1 ∩ G.neighborFinset y.1).erase v).card ≤
      (starCommonNeighbors G (sampledLeftVertices G A X v) X x y).card

    let L : Finset S := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => x.1 ∈ A)

name: HadwigerLean.reservoirNonNeighbors_sample_ratio_le
statement:
theorem reservoirNonNeighbors_sample_ratio_le
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (Z : Finset V) (r ℓ : ℕ) (i : Fin r) (v : V)
    (hsize : r * ℓ ≤ Z.card) :
    ((restrictedEmbeddings (blockPositions r ℓ i)
      (reservoirNonNeighbors G Z v)).card : ℝ) /
        (Fintype.card ((Fin r × Fin ℓ) ↪ (Z : Set V)) : ℝ) ≤
      (((Gᶜ).degree v : ℝ) /
        ((Z.card + 1 - ℓ : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ ℓ

name: HadwigerLean.restrictedEmbeddings_ratio_le_power

theorem restrictedEmbeddings_ratio_le_power [Fintype β]

    ((restrictedEmbeddings T C).card : ℝ) /
        (Fintype.card (D ↪ β) : ℝ) ≤
      ((C.card : ℝ) /
        ((Fintype.card β + 1 - T.card : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ T.card

theorem sampledBlock_subset_reservoirNonNeighbors_iff

name: HadwigerLean.card_conditionalEmbeddings
statement:
theorem card_conditionalEmbeddings
    (T : Finset D) (U : Finset (↥((T : Set D)ᶜ)))
    (C : ∀ g : ((T : Set D) ↪ β),
      Finset (↥((Set.range g)ᶜ))) :
    (conditionalEmbeddings T U C).card =
      ∑ g : ((T : Set D) ↪ β),
        (restrictedEmbeddings U (C g)).card

name: HadwigerLean.card_conditionalEmbeddings_le_power
statement:
theorem card_conditionalEmbeddings_le_power
    (T : Finset D) (U : Finset (↥((T : Set D)ᶜ)))
    (C : ∀ g : ((T : Set D) ↪ β),
      Finset (↥((Set.range g)ᶜ)))
    (c : ℝ) (hd : Fintype.card D ≤ Fintype.card β)
    (hC : ∀ g, ((C g).card : ℝ) ≤ c) :
    ((conditionalEmbeddings T U C).card : ℝ) ≤
      (Fintype.card (D ↪ β) : ℝ) *
        (c /
          ((Fintype.card β - T.card + 1 - U.card : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ U.card

name: HadwigerLean.exists_sample_with_many_crossing_blocks
statement:
theorem exists_sample_with_many_crossing_blocks
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t)
    (Z : Finset V)
    (hn : 9 * t ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hZ : Z.card = Fintype.card V / 3)
    (hgood : ∀ v ∈ Z,
      Fintype.card V * (Gᶜ).degree v ≤ 4 * edgeCount Gᶜ)
    (hpower : 6 * (t : ℝ) *
      (100 * ((edgeCount Gᶜ : ℝ) /
        ((Fintype.card V).choose 2 : ℝ))) ^
          ((Fintype.card V / (9 * t)) ^ 2) ≤ 1) :
    let ℓ := Fintype.card V / (9 * t)
    ∃ f : (Fin (3 * t) × Fin ℓ) ↪ (Z : Set V),
      t ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (2 * t) =>
        ∀ j : Fin t,
          ∃ x ∈ sampledBlock Z (3 * t) ℓ f (xBlockLabel t i),
            ∃ y ∈ sampledBlock Z (3 * t) ℓ f (yBlockLabel t j),
              G.Adj x y)).card

statement:
theorem good_first_conditional_rate_le
    (n den ℓ : ℕ) (c q : ℝ)
    (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hgap : n ≤ 4 * den)
    (hgood : c ≤ 3 * (n : ℝ) * (8 * q) ^ ℓ) :
    (c / (den : ℝ)) ^ ℓ ≤
      (100 * q) ^ (ℓ ^ 2)

name: HadwigerLean.good_pair_failure_count_le
statement:
theorem good_pair_failure_count_le
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (Z : Finset V) (r ℓ : ℕ) (i j : Fin r) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (hn : 1 ≤ Fintype.card V) (hℓ : 1 ≤ ℓ)
    (hsize : r * ℓ ≤ Z.card)
    (hgap : Fintype.card V ≤ 4 * (Z.card + 1 - 2 * ℓ)) :
    let q : ℝ := (edgeCount Gᶜ : ℝ) /
      ((Fintype.card V).choose 2 : ℝ);
    let c : ℝ := 3 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * (8 * q) ^ ℓ;
    ((Finset.univ.filter
      (fun f : (Fin r × Fin ℓ) ↪ (Z : Set V) =>
        ((exceptionalAfterFirst G Z (blockPositions r ℓ i)
          (splitEmbeddingEquiv (blockPositions r ℓ i) f).1).card : ℝ) ≤ c ∧
        ∀ x ∈ sampledBlock Z r ℓ f i,
          ∀ y ∈ sampledBlock Z r ℓ f j, ¬ G.Adj x y)).card : ℝ) ≤
      (Fintype.card ((Fin r × Fin ℓ) ↪ (Z : Set V)) : ℝ) *
        (100 * q) ^ (ℓ ^ 2)

name: HadwigerLean.half_samples_avoid_all_failures
statement:
theorem half_samples_avoid_all_failures
    {Ω J : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J]
    (Good : Ω → Prop) (Fail : J → Ω → Prop)
    [DecidablePred Good] [∀ j, DecidablePred (Fail j)]
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hgood : 2 * Fintype.card Ω ≤
      3 * (Finset.univ.filter Good).card)
    (hfail : ∀ j,
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun ω => Good ω ∧ Fail j ω)).card : ℝ) ≤
        (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) * p)
    (hsmall : 6 * (Fintype.card J : ℝ) * p ≤ 1) :
    Fintype.card Ω ≤
      2 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun ω =>
        Good ω ∧ ∀ j, ¬ Fail j ω)).card

name: HadwigerLean.half_samples_first_block_crosses_all
statement:
theorem half_samples_first_block_crosses_all
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t)
    (Z : Finset V) (i : Fin (2 * t))

        ((Fintype.card V).choose 2 : ℝ))) ^
          ((Fintype.card V / (9 * t)) ^ 2) ≤ 1) :
    let ℓ := Fintype.card V / (9 * t)
    Fintype.card ((Fin (3 * t) × Fin ℓ) ↪ (Z : Set V)) ≤
      2 * (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun f : (Fin (3 * t) × Fin ℓ) ↪ (Z : Set V) =>

name: HadwigerLean.hasCliqueMinor_of_successful_sample
statement:
theorem hasCliqueMinor_of_successful_sample
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]

    (f : (Fin (3 * t) × Fin (Fintype.card V / (9 * t))) ↪ (Z : Set V))

statement:

name: HadwigerLean.two_thirds_samples_good_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem two_thirds_samples_good_of_nonneg
    {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]

    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hp : 48 * k ≤ p)
    (hH : H.Nonempty) (hHS : H ⊆ S) (hSX : Disjoint S X)
    (hmin : ∀ v ∈ S, 4 * p ≤ (G.neighborFinset v ∩ S).card)
    (hratio : ∀ v ∈ S, G.degree v ≤
      3 * (G.neighborFinset v ∩ S).card)
    (hloss : connectedSetContractionLoss G H ≤ p * (H.card - 1))
    (hmax : ∀ v ∈ localRPrime G H X S,
      p * H.card < connectedSetContractionLoss G (insert v H))
    (hX : ∀ v ∈ S, 2 * (G.neighborFinset v ∩ X).card < p) :
    ∃ (W : Type u) (_ : Fintype W) (f : W ↪ V),
      Fintype.card W ≤ (localR G H X).card ∧

      VertexConnected (G.comap f) k

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ci_linear_stage_budgets
statement:
theorem ci_linear_stage_budgets
    (t s r x χ : ℕ)
    (ht : 3 ≤ t) (hx : x ≤ t) (hrx : r * x ≤ 3 * t)
    (hχ : 2 * ciChromaticBudget t s ≤ χ) :
    (r * x + ciPieceConnectivity t ≤ ciConnectivity t) ∧
    (ciLocalChromatic t s +
      2 * (480 * 6400 * ciPieceConnectivity t) +
      ciChromaticBudget t s / 2 + r * x < χ) ∧
    (ciChromaticBudget t s / 2 + r * x +
      ciLocalChromatic t s + 4 * (3 * r * x) +
      7 * ciConnectivity t ≤ χ) ∧
    (ciChromaticBudget t s / 2 + r * x +
      ciLocalChromatic t s + 4 * (3 * r * x) +
      6 * ciConnectivity t ≤ ciChromaticBudget t s) ∧
    (3 * (3 * r * x) ≤ ciConnectivity t) ∧
    (2 * (3 * r * x) ≤ ciPieceConnectivity t) ∧
    (3 * r * x + 2 * (r * x) ≤ ciConnectivity t) ∧
    (2 * (r * x) ≤ ciConnectivity t) ∧
    (2 * (r * x) ≤ ciPieceConnectivity t) ∧
    (2 * x ≤ ciPieceConnectivity t) ∧
    (33 * ((4 * r + 1) * x) ≤ ciPieceConnectivity t) ∧
    (12 * ciConnectivity t ≤ ciChromaticBudget t s) ∧
    (ciLocalChromatic t s + 2 * (r * x) +
      7 * ciConnectivity t ≤ χ) ∧
    (ciLocalChromatic t s + 2 * (r * x) +
      6 * ciConnectivity t ≤ ciChromaticBudget t s / 2) ∧
    (ciChromaticBudget t s / 2 + ciConnectivity t ≤
      ciChromaticBudget t s)
