name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.stageBlockSize_root_log_bound
statement:
theorem stageBlockSize_root_log_bound
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) :
    (((2 * stageBlockSize t : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      Real.sqrt (Real.log (((2 * stageBlockSize t : ℕ) : ℝ)))) ≤
        4 * (t : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.stageCount_le_two_log
statement:
theorem stageCount_le_two_log
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) :
    (stageCount t : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Real.log (t : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.stageCount_le_two_sqrt_log
statement:
theorem stageCount_le_two_sqrt_log
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) :
    (stageCount t : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Real.sqrt (Real.log (t : ℝ))

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.stageCount_mul_block_ge
statement:
theorem stageCount_mul_block_ge (t : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) :
    t ≤ stageCount t * stageBlockSize t

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.stageCount_mul_block_le_three
statement:
theorem stageCount_mul_block_le_three
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) :
    stageCount t * stageBlockSize t ≤ 3 * t

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.stageCount_pos
statement:
theorem stageCount_pos (t : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) :
    0 < stageCount t

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.stageCount_sub_one_mul_block_le
statement:
theorem stageCount_sub_one_mul_block_le
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) :
    (stageCount t - 1) * stageBlockSize t ≤ 2 * t

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.stageIndex_mul_block_le
statement:
theorem stageIndex_mul_block_le
    (t p : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) (hp : p < stageCount t) :
    p * stageBlockSize t ≤ 2 * t

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ciCoreBound_local_window
statement:
theorem ciCoreBound_local_window
    (t : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) :
    ((3 * ciCoreBound (ciPieceOrderBound t)
      (stageBlockSize t) (stageCount t) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
      (ciCoefficient : ℝ) * (t : ℝ) *
        (Real.log (t : ℝ))^4

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ciPieceOrderBound_ge
statement:
theorem ciPieceOrderBound_ge (t : ℕ) :
    (480 * 6400 : ℝ)^2 * (t : ℝ) *
      (Real.log (t : ℝ))^3 ≤ (ciPieceOrderBound t : ℝ)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.chromatic_union_le_two_of_no_cross
statement:
theorem chromatic_union_le_two_of_no_cross
    (A B : Finset V)
    (hA : chromatic (G.induce (A : Set V)) ≤ 2)
    (hB : chromatic (G.induce (B : Set V)) ≤ 2)
    (hno : ∀ {a b : V}, a ∈ A → b ∈ B → ¬ G.Adj a b) :
    chromatic (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)) ≤ 2

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.exists_shortest_stem_to_set
statement:
theorem exists_shortest_stem_to_set
    (hconn : G.Connected) (Q : Finset V) (hQ : Q.Nonempty)
    (v : V) :
    ∃ (b : V) (p : G.Walk v b), b ∈ Q ∧ p.IsPath ∧
      p.IsChordless ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ p.support → z ∈ Q → z = b) ∧
      (∀ z, z ∈ p.support → z ≠ b → z ≠ p.penultimate →
        ∀ y ∈ Q, ¬ G.Adj z y)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.cheap_tree_add_outside
statement:
theorem cheap_tree_add_outside
    (hconn : G.Connected)
    (Q₀ T₀ : Finset V) (v : V)
    (hQconn : (G.induce (Q₀ : Set V)).Connected)
    (hTQ : T₀ ⊆ Q₀)
    (hχ : chromatic (G.induce ((Q₀ \ T₀ : Finset V) : Set V)) ≤ 2)
    (hv : v ∉ Q₀) :
    ∃ Q T : Finset V,
      Q₀ ⊆ Q ∧ v ∈ Q ∧
      T₀ ⊆ T ∧ v ∈ T ∧ T ⊆ Q ∧
      T.card ≤ T₀.card + 3 ∧
      (G.induce (Q : Set V)).Connected ∧
      chromatic (G.induce ((Q \ T : Finset V) : Set V)) ≤ 2

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.exists_cheap_tree
statement:
theorem exists_cheap_tree
    (hconn : G.Connected) (S : Finset V) (hS : S.Nonempty) :
    ∃ Q T : Finset V,
      S ⊆ T ∧ T ⊆ Q ∧ T.card ≤ 3 * S.card ∧
      (G.induce (Q : Set V)).Connected ∧
      chromatic (G.induce ((Q \ T : Finset V) : Set V)) ≤ 2

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.exists_disjoint_connectors_of_vertexConnected
statement:
theorem exists_disjoint_connectors_of_vertexConnected
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (A B : Finset V) (k m : ℕ)
    (hconn : VertexConnected G k) (hm : m ≤ k)
    (hA : m ≤ A.card) (hB : m ≤ B.card) :
    ∃ (P : IndexedPairs (Fin m) V) (L : IndexedLinkage G P),
      SetMenger.IsABLinkage L A B

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.RedundantFan.cut_card
statement:
theorem cut_card (G : SimpleGraph V) (A B C Q : Finset V)
    (F : RedundantFan G A B C)
    (hsep : SetMenger.IsABSeparator G (A ∪ C) B Q) :
    2 * (A \ Q).card ≤ (Q \ (A ∪ C)).card

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.exists_linkage_of_two_redundant_fans
statement:
theorem exists_linkage_of_two_redundant_fans
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (A₁ A₂ B : Finset V)
    (hdis : Disjoint A₁ A₂)
    (F₁ : RedundantFan G A₁ B A₂)
    (F₂ : RedundantFan G A₂ B A₁) :
    ∃ (P : IndexedPairs (Fin (A₁.card + A₂.card)) V)
      (L : IndexedLinkage G P),
      SetMenger.IsABLinkage L (A₁ ∪ A₂) B

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleCloneSources_card
statement:
theorem doubleCloneSources_card (Z : Finset V) :
    (doubleCloneSources Z).card = 2 * Z.card

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleClone_mem_sources
statement:
@[simp] theorem doubleClone_mem_sources (Z : Finset V) (z : Z) (i : Fin 2) :
    doubleClone Z z i ∈ doubleCloneSources Z

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleCloneCollapse_liftVertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem doubleCloneCollapse_liftVertex
    (Z D : Finset V) (z : Z) (i : Fin 2)
    (hD : Z.erase z.1 ⊆ D)
    (v : {x : V | x ∉ D}) :
    doubleCloneCollapse Z (doubleCloneLiftVertex Z D z i hD v) = v.1

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleCloneLiftVertex_injective
statement:
theorem doubleCloneLiftVertex_injective
    (Z D : Finset V) (z : Z) (i : Fin 2)
    (hD : Z.erase z.1 ⊆ D) :
    Function.Injective (doubleCloneLiftVertex Z D z i hD)

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleCloneLiftVertex_not_mem_cut
statement:
theorem doubleCloneLiftVertex_not_mem_cut
    (Z : Finset V) (Q : Finset (DoubleCloneVertex V Z))
    (D : Finset V) (z : Z) (i : Fin 2)
    (hclone : doubleClone Z z i ∉ Q)
    (hZ : Z.erase z.1 ⊆ D)
    (hcut : doubleCloneOriginalCut Z Q ⊆ D)
    (v : {x : V | x ∉ D}) :
    doubleCloneLiftVertex Z D z i hZ v ∉ Q

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleCloneOriginalCut_card_le
statement:
theorem doubleCloneOriginalCut_card_le
    (Z : Finset V) (Q : Finset (DoubleCloneVertex V Z)) :
    (doubleCloneOriginalCut Z Q).card ≤ Q.card

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleCloneTarget_mem_cut_iff
statement:
theorem doubleCloneTarget_mem_cut_iff
    (Z : Finset V) (Q : Finset (DoubleCloneVertex V Z))
    (v : V) (hv : v ∉ Z) :
    doubleCloneTarget Z v hv ∈ Q ↔
      v ∈ doubleCloneOriginalCut Z Q

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleCloneTarget_mem_targets
statement:
@[simp] theorem doubleCloneTarget_mem_targets
    (Z H : Finset V) (hdis : Disjoint Z H)
    (h : H) :
    doubleCloneTarget Z h.1
      (fun hv => (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hdis) hv h.2) ∈
      doubleCloneTargets Z H hdis

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleCloneTargets_card
statement:
theorem doubleCloneTargets_card
    (Z H : Finset V) (hdis : Disjoint Z H) :
    (doubleCloneTargets Z H hdis).card = H.card

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleClone_path_avoiding_cut
statement:
theorem doubleClone_path_avoiding_cut
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (Z : Finset V)
    (Q : Finset (DoubleCloneVertex V Z))
    (D : Finset V) (z : Z) (i : Fin 2)
    (hclone : doubleClone Z z i ∉ Q)
    (hZ : Z.erase z.1 ⊆ D)
    (hcut : doubleCloneOriginalCut Z Q ⊆ D)
    (hzD : z.1 ∉ D)
    (h : V) (hhD : h ∉ D) (hhZ : h ∉ Z)
    (hconn : (G.induce (D : Set V)ᶜ).Connected) :
    ∃ p : (doubleCloneGraph G Z).Path
        (doubleClone Z z i) (doubleCloneTarget Z h hhZ),
      ∀ x ∈ pathVertexSet p, x ∉ Q

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleClone_separator_card_ge
statement:
theorem doubleClone_separator_card_ge
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (Z H : Finset V) (r : ℕ)
    (hconn : VertexConnected G r)
    (hr : 3 * Z.card ≤ r)
    (hH : 2 * Z.card ≤ H.card)
    (hdis : Disjoint Z H)
    (Q : Finset (DoubleCloneVertex V Z))
    (hsep : SetMenger.IsABSeparator (doubleCloneGraph G Z)
      (doubleCloneSources Z) (doubleCloneTargets Z H hdis) Q) :
    2 * Z.card ≤ Q.card

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.exists_double_clone_linkage
statement:
theorem exists_double_clone_linkage
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (Z H : Finset V) (r : ℕ)
    (hconn : VertexConnected G r)
    (hr : 3 * Z.card ≤ r)
    (hH : 2 * Z.card ≤ H.card)
    (hdis : Disjoint Z H) :
    ∃ (P : IndexedPairs (Fin (2 * Z.card))
        (DoubleCloneVertex V Z))
      (L : IndexedLinkage (doubleCloneGraph G Z) P),
      SetMenger.IsABLinkage L
        (doubleCloneSources Z) (doubleCloneTargets Z H hdis)

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleClone_slot_index
statement:
theorem doubleClone_slot_index
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (Z H : Finset V)
    (hdis : Disjoint Z H)
    (P : IndexedPairs (Fin (2 * Z.card))
      (DoubleCloneVertex V Z))
    (L : IndexedLinkage (doubleCloneGraph G Z) P)
    (hAB : SetMenger.IsABLinkage L
      (doubleCloneSources Z) (doubleCloneTargets Z H hdis)) :
    ∃ f : Z × Fin 2 → Fin (2 * Z.card),
      Function.Injective f ∧
      ∀ slot, P.start (f slot) =
        doubleClone Z slot.1 slot.2

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleClone_start_surjective
statement:
theorem doubleClone_start_surjective
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (Z H : Finset V)
    (hdis : Disjoint Z H)
    (P : IndexedPairs (Fin (2 * Z.card))
      (DoubleCloneVertex V Z))
    (L : IndexedLinkage (doubleCloneGraph G Z) P)
    (hAB : SetMenger.IsABLinkage L
      (doubleCloneSources Z) (doubleCloneTargets Z H hdis))
    (c : DoubleCloneVertex V Z)
    (hc : c ∈ doubleCloneSources Z) :
    ∃ j : Fin (2 * Z.card), P.start j = c

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.collapseClonePath_disjoint_outside
statement:
theorem collapseClonePath_disjoint_outside
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (Z H : Finset V)
    (hdis : Disjoint Z H)
    (P : IndexedPairs (Fin (2 * Z.card))
      (DoubleCloneVertex V Z))
    (L : IndexedLinkage (doubleCloneGraph G Z) P)
    (hAB : SetMenger.IsABLinkage L
      (doubleCloneSources Z) (doubleCloneTargets Z H hdis))
    (j l : Fin (2 * Z.card)) (hjl : j ≠ l) :
    Disjoint
      (pathVertexSet (collapseClonePath G Z H hdis P L hAB j) \ (Z : Set V))
      (pathVertexSet (collapseClonePath G Z H hdis P L hAB l) \ (Z : Set V))

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.collapseClonePath_source_only
statement:
theorem collapseClonePath_source_only
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (Z H : Finset V)
    (hdis : Disjoint Z H)
    (P : IndexedPairs (Fin (2 * Z.card))
      (DoubleCloneVertex V Z))
    (L : IndexedLinkage (doubleCloneGraph G Z) P)
    (hAB : SetMenger.IsABLinkage L
      (doubleCloneSources Z) (doubleCloneTargets Z H hdis))
    (j : Fin (2 * Z.card)) (v : V)
    (hv : v ∈ pathVertexSet (collapseClonePath G Z H hdis P L hAB j))
    (hvZ : v ∈ Z) :
    v = doubleCloneCollapse Z (P.start j)

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleClone_collapse_injOn_path
statement:
theorem doubleClone_collapse_injOn_path
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (Z H : Finset V)
    (hdis : Disjoint Z H)
    (P : IndexedPairs (Fin (2 * Z.card))
      (DoubleCloneVertex V Z))
    (L : IndexedLinkage (doubleCloneGraph G Z) P)
    (hAB : SetMenger.IsABLinkage L
      (doubleCloneSources Z) (doubleCloneTargets Z H hdis))
    (j : Fin (2 * Z.card)) :
    ∀ x ∈ pathVertexSet (L.path j),
      ∀ y ∈ pathVertexSet (L.path j),
        doubleCloneCollapse Z x = doubleCloneCollapse Z y →
          x = y

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleClone_finish_mem_hub
statement:
theorem doubleClone_finish_mem_hub
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (Z H : Finset V)
    (hdis : Disjoint Z H)
    (P : IndexedPairs (Fin (2 * Z.card))
      (DoubleCloneVertex V Z))
    (L : IndexedLinkage (doubleCloneGraph G Z) P)
    (hAB : SetMenger.IsABLinkage L
      (doubleCloneSources Z) (doubleCloneTargets Z H hdis))
    (j : Fin (2 * Z.card)) :
    doubleCloneCollapse Z (P.finish j) ∈ H

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.doubleClone_path_only_own_clone
statement:
theorem doubleClone_path_only_own_clone
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (Z H : Finset V)
    (hdis : Disjoint Z H)
    (P : IndexedPairs (Fin (2 * Z.card))
      (DoubleCloneVertex V Z))
    (L : IndexedLinkage (doubleCloneGraph G Z) P)
    (hAB : SetMenger.IsABLinkage L
      (doubleCloneSources Z) (doubleCloneTargets Z H hdis))
    (j : Fin (2 * Z.card))
    (c : DoubleCloneVertex V Z)
    (hc : c ∈ pathVertexSet (L.path j))
    (hcA : c ∈ doubleCloneSources Z) :
    c = P.start j

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.mem_collapseClonePath_iff
statement:
theorem mem_collapseClonePath_iff
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (Z H : Finset V)
    (hdis : Disjoint Z H)
    (P : IndexedPairs (Fin (2 * Z.card))
      (DoubleCloneVertex V Z))
    (L : IndexedLinkage (doubleCloneGraph G Z) P)
    (hAB : SetMenger.IsABLinkage L
      (doubleCloneSources Z) (doubleCloneTargets Z H hdis))
    (j : Fin (2 * Z.card)) (v : V) :
    v ∈ pathVertexSet (collapseClonePath G Z H hdis P L hAB j) ↔
      ∃ c ∈ pathVertexSet (L.path j), doubleCloneCollapse Z c = v

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.exists_double_fan_of_vertexConnected
statement:
theorem exists_double_fan_of_vertexConnected
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (Z H : Finset V) (r : ℕ)
    (hconn : VertexConnected G r)
    (hr : 3 * Z.card ≤ r)
    (hH : 2 * Z.card ≤ H.card)
    (hdis : Disjoint Z H) :
    Nonempty (DoubleFan G Z H)

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.DoubleFan.chromatic_vertexFinset_le_four_mul
statement:
theorem DoubleFan.chromatic_vertexFinset_le_four_mul
    (F : DoubleFan G Z H)
    (hchord : ∀ slot,
      (F.path slot : G.Walk slot.1.1 (F.finish slot)).IsChordless) :
    chromatic (G.induce (F.vertexFinset : Set V)) ≤ 4 * Z.card

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.DoubleFan.chromatic_le_source_hub_fan_residual
statement:
theorem DoubleFan.chromatic_le_source_hub_fan_residual
    (F : DoubleFan G Z H) (hfan :
      chromatic (G.induce (F.vertexFinset : Set V)) ≤ 4 * Z.card) :
    chromatic G ≤ Z.card + chromatic (G.induce (H : Set V)) +
      4 * Z.card +
      chromatic (G.induce ((Z ∪ H ∪ F.vertexFinset : Finset V) : Set V)ᶜ)

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.chromatic_induce_le_add_remainder
statement:
theorem chromatic_induce_le_add_remainder
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (S A : Set V) :
    chromatic (G.induce S) ≤
      chromatic (G.induce A) + chromatic (G.induce (S \ A))

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.overlap_card_ge_of_chromatic_inseparable
statement:
theorem overlap_card_ge_of_chromatic_inseparable
    (A B : Finset V) (k m : ℕ)
    (hinsep : ¬ Bootstrap.ChromaticSeparable G m)
    (hχA : chromatic G ≤ chromatic (G.induce (A : Set V)) + m)
    (hχB : chromatic G ≤ chromatic (G.induce (B : Set V)) + m / 2)
    (hbudget : m / 2 + k ≤ m) :
    k ≤ (A ∩ B).card

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.connected_induce_sdiff_of_vertexConnected
statement:
theorem connected_induce_sdiff_of_vertexConnected
    (A U : Finset V) (k : ℕ)
    (hA : VertexConnected (G.induce (A : Set V)) k)
    (hU : U.card < k) :
    (G.induce ((A \ U : Finset V) : Set V)).Connected

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.vertexConnected_union_of_large_overlap
statement:
theorem vertexConnected_union_of_large_overlap
    (A B : Finset V) (k : ℕ)
    (hA : VertexConnected (G.induce (A : Set V)) k)
    (hB : VertexConnected (G.induce (B : Set V)) k)
    (hoverlap : k ≤ (A ∩ B).card) :
    VertexConnected (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)) k

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.chromatic_biUnion_le_two_mul
statement:
theorem chromatic_biUnion_le_two_mul
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (R : ι → Finset V)
    (hR : ∀ i, chromatic (G.induce (R i : Set V)) ≤ 2)
    (F : Finset ι) :
    chromatic (G.induce ((F.biUnion R : Finset V) : Set V)) ≤
      2 * F.card

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.chromatic_induce_union_le_add
statement:
theorem chromatic_induce_union_le_add
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (A B : Finset V) :
    chromatic (G.induce ((A ∪ B : Finset V) : Set V)) ≤
      chromatic (G.induce (A : Set V)) +
        chromatic (G.induce (B : Set V))

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.chromatic_model_union_le_marked_add_two_mul
statement:
theorem chromatic_model_union_le_marked_add_two_mul
    (G : SimpleGraph V) {s L : ℕ}
    (Q T : Fin s → Finset V)
    (hrem : ∀ i,
      chromatic (G.induce ((Q i \ T i : Finset V) : Set V)) ≤ 2)
    (hmark : chromatic (G.induce
      (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin s)).biUnion T : Finset V) : Set V)) ≤ L) :
    chromatic (G.induce
      (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin s)).biUnion Q : Finset V) : Set V)) ≤
      L + 2 * s

name: HadwigerLean.IndexedLinkage.extendFromInduced_vertices_subset
statement:
theorem extendFromInduced_vertices_subset
    (L : IndexedLinkage (G.induce S) Q)
    (hP : P.DisjointTerminals)
    (houtside : ∀ i, P.start i ∉ S ∧ P.finish i ∉ S)
    (hstart : ∀ i, G.Adj (P.start i) (Q.start i).1)
    (hfinish : ∀ i, G.Adj (Q.finish i).1 (P.finish i)) :
    (L.extendFromInduced hP houtside hstart hfinish).vertices ⊆
      P.allTerminals ∪ (Subtype.val '' L.vertices)

name: HadwigerLean.RootedMinorModel.extendFromInduced_vertices_subset
statement:
theorem extendFromInduced_vertices_subset
    (M : RootedMinorModel (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin a))
      (G.induce S) proxy)
    (root : Fin a → V)
    (hroot : Function.Injective root)
    (houtside : ∀ i, root i ∉ S)
    (hadj : ∀ i, G.Adj (root i) (proxy i).1) :
    (M.extendFromInduced root hroot houtside hadj).toMinorModel.vertices ⊆
      Set.range root ∪ (Subtype.val '' M.toMinorModel.vertices)

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.exists_normalized_proxies
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_proxies
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (root : Fin a → V) (P : IndexedPairs (Fin j) V)
    (hdegree : ∀ i, 2 * (a + 2 * j) ≤ G.degree (originalRoleFin root P i)) :
    ∃ proxy : Fin (a + 2 * j) → normalizedSet root P,
      Function.Injective proxy ∧
      ∀ i, G.Adj (originalRoleFin root P i) (proxy i).1

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.occupiedRoles_card_le
statement:
theorem occupiedRoles_card_le
    (root : Fin a → V) (P : IndexedPairs (Fin j) V) :
    (occupiedRoles root P).card ≤ a + 2 * j

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.originalRole_mem_occupied
statement:
theorem originalRole_mem_occupied
    (root : Fin a → V) (P : IndexedPairs (Fin j) V)
    (slot : DistinctRoleIndex a j) :
    originalRole root P slot ∈ occupiedRoles root P

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.root_not_normalized
statement:
theorem root_not_normalized
    (root : Fin a → V) (P : IndexedPairs (Fin j) V)
    (i : Fin a) : root i ∉ normalizedSet root P

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.terminals_not_normalized
statement:
theorem terminals_not_normalized
    (root : Fin a → V) (P : IndexedPairs (Fin j) V)
    (i : Fin j) :
    P.start i ∉ normalizedSet root P ∧
      P.finish i ∉ normalizedSet root P

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.first_stage_uniformCliqueK_le
statement:
theorem first_stage_uniformCliqueK_le
    (t C : ℕ) (ht : 3 ≤ t) (hC : 9000000 ≤ C) :
    HadwigerLean.Woven.uniformCliqueK (stageBlockSize t) 0 ≤ C * t

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.blockOwner_eq_new_iff
statement:
theorem blockOwner_eq_new_iff (p : ℕ) (k : Fin (4 * p + 1)) :
    blockOwner p k = Sum.inr () ↔
      (∃ i : Fin p, k.val = p + 2 * i.val + 1) ∨
      k.val = 4 * p

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.blockOwner_eq_old_iff
statement:
theorem blockOwner_eq_old_iff (p : ℕ) (k : Fin (4 * p + 1))
    (i : Fin p) :
    blockOwner p k = Sum.inl i ↔
      k.val = i.val ∨
      k.val = p + 2 * i.val ∨
      k.val = 3 * p + i.val

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.blockOwner_new_final
statement:
theorem blockOwner_new_final (p : ℕ) :
    blockOwner p ⟨4 * p, by omega⟩ = Sum.inr ()

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.blockOwner_new_middle
statement:
theorem blockOwner_new_middle (p : ℕ) (i : Fin p) :
    blockOwner p ⟨p + 2 * i.val + 1, by omega⟩ = Sum.inr ()

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.blockOwner_old_final
statement:
theorem blockOwner_old_final (p : ℕ) (i : Fin p) :
    blockOwner p ⟨3 * p + i.val, by omega⟩ = Sum.inl i

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.blockOwner_old_middle
statement:
theorem blockOwner_old_middle (p : ℕ) (i : Fin p) :
    blockOwner p ⟨p + 2 * i.val, by omega⟩ = Sum.inl i

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.blockOwner_old_start
statement:
theorem blockOwner_old_start (p : ℕ) (i : Fin p) :
    blockOwner p ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = Sum.inl i

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.newTerminals_card
statement:
theorem newTerminals_card (p x : ℕ) (r : Fin x) :
    (newTerminals p x r).card = p + 1

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.newTerminals_disjoint
statement:
theorem newTerminals_disjoint (p x : ℕ)
    (r s : Fin x) (hrs : r ≠ s) :
    Disjoint (newTerminals p x r) (newTerminals p x s)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.newTerminals_eq
statement:
theorem newTerminals_eq (p x : ℕ) (r : Fin x) :
    newTerminals p x r =
      insert (finProdFinEquiv ((⟨4 * p, by omega⟩ : Fin (4 * p + 1)), r))
        (Finset.univ.image (fun i : Fin p =>
          finProdFinEquiv
            ((⟨p + 2 * i.val + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (4 * p + 1)), r)))

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.oldTerminals_card
statement:
theorem oldTerminals_card (p x : ℕ) (i : Fin p) (r : Fin x) :
    (oldTerminals p x i r).card = 3

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.oldTerminals_disjoint
statement:
theorem oldTerminals_disjoint (p x : ℕ)
    (z w : Fin p × Fin x) (hzw : z ≠ w) :
    Disjoint (oldTerminals p x z.1 z.2)
      (oldTerminals p x w.1 w.2)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.oldTerminals_disjoint_newTerminals
statement:
theorem oldTerminals_disjoint_newTerminals (p x : ℕ)
    (z : Fin p × Fin x) (r : Fin x) :
    Disjoint (oldTerminals p x z.1 z.2) (newTerminals p x r)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.oldTerminals_eq_three
statement:
theorem oldTerminals_eq_three (p x : ℕ) (i : Fin p) (r : Fin x) :
    oldTerminals p x i r =
      { finProdFinEquiv ((⟨i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (4 * p + 1)), r),
        finProdFinEquiv ((⟨p + 2 * i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (4 * p + 1)), r),
        finProdFinEquiv ((⟨3 * p + i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (4 * p + 1)), r) }

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.pathOwner_new_final
statement:
theorem pathOwner_new_final (p x : ℕ) (r : Fin x) :
    pathOwner p x (finProdFinEquiv (⟨4 * p, by omega⟩, r)) =
      Sum.inr r

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.pathOwner_new_middle
statement:
theorem pathOwner_new_middle (p x : ℕ) (i : Fin p) (r : Fin x) :
    pathOwner p x
      (finProdFinEquiv (⟨p + 2 * i.val + 1, by omega⟩, r)) =
      Sum.inr r

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.pathOwner_old_final
statement:
theorem pathOwner_old_final (p x : ℕ) (i : Fin p) (r : Fin x) :
    pathOwner p x
      (finProdFinEquiv ((⟨3 * p + i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (4 * p + 1)), r)) =
      Sum.inl (i, r)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.pathOwner_old_middle
statement:
theorem pathOwner_old_middle (p x : ℕ) (i : Fin p) (r : Fin x) :
    pathOwner p x
      (finProdFinEquiv ((⟨p + 2 * i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (4 * p + 1)), r)) =
      Sum.inl (i, r)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.pathOwner_old_start
statement:
theorem pathOwner_old_start (p x : ℕ) (i : Fin p) (r : Fin x) :
    pathOwner p x (finProdFinEquiv ((⟨i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (4 * p + 1)), r)) =
      Sum.inl (i, r)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.path_index_has_unique_group
statement:
theorem path_index_has_unique_group (p x : ℕ)
    (k : Fin ((4 * p + 1) * x)) :
    (∃! z : Fin p × Fin x, k ∈ oldTerminals p x z.1 z.2) ∨
      (∃! r : Fin x, k ∈ newTerminals p x r)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.exists_stage_zero
statement:
theorem exists_stage_zero
    {V : Type u} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (k m : ℕ)
    (hk : 0 < k) (hχ : 7 * k ≤ chromatic G)
    (hm : 12 * k ≤ m) :
    Nonempty (StageState G 0 k (m / 2) 0)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.assemble_raw_rooted_clique_model
statement:
theorem assemble_raw_rooted_clique_model
    {V : Type u} {I : Type v} {J K : Type*}
    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (C : I → Set V) (P : K → Set V) (owner : K → I)
    (E : I → J → Set V) (extra : I → Finset J)
    (root : I → V) (H core : Set V)
    (hC : ∀ i, (G.induce (C i)).Connected)
    (hP : ∀ k, (G.induce (P k)).Connected)
    (hPmeet : ∀ k, ∃ v, v ∈ C (owner k) ∧ v ∈ P k)
    (hE : ∀ i j, j ∈ extra i → (G.induce (E i j)).Connected)
    (hEmeet : ∀ i j, j ∈ extra i →
      ∃ v, v ∈ C i ∪ assignedPaths owner P i ∧ v ∈ E i j)
    (hBaseDisjoint : ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      Disjoint (branchBase C E extra i) (branchBase C E extra j))
    (hPathBaseDisjoint : ∀ k i, owner k ≠ i →
      Disjoint (P k) (branchBase C E extra i))
    (hPathDisjoint : ∀ k l, k ≠ l → Disjoint (P k) (P l))
    (hRootPath : ∀ i, root i ∈ assignedPaths owner P i)
    (hBaseH : ∀ i, Disjoint (branchBase C E extra i) H)
    (hPathH : ∀ i, assignedPaths owner P i ∩ H = {root i})
    (hRootCore : ∀ i, root i ∈ core)
    (hBaseWitness : ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      ∃ a ∈ branchBase C E extra i,
        ∃ b ∈ branchBase C E extra j,
          a ∈ core ∧ b ∈ core ∧ G.Adj a b) :
    ∃ M : RootedMinorModel (SimpleGraph.completeGraph I) G root,
      (∀ i, M.branch i = assembledBranch C P owner E extra i) ∧
      (∀ i, M.branch i ∩ H = {root i}) ∧
      (∀ i j, i ≠ j →
        ∃ a ∈ M.branch i, ∃ b ∈ M.branch j,
          a ∈ core ∧ b ∈ core ∧ G.Adj a b) ∧
      M.toMinorModel.vertices ∩ H ⊆ core

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.connected_patch_union_finset
statement:
theorem connected_patch_union_finset
    {V : Type u} {J : Type v} [DecidableEq J]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (C : Set V) (P : J → Set V)
    (hC : (G.induce C).Connected)
    (S : Finset J) (hP : ∀ j ∈ S, (G.induce (P j)).Connected)
    (hmeet : ∀ j ∈ S, ∃ v, v ∈ C ∧ v ∈ P j)
    :
    (G.induce (C ∪ ⋃ j ∈ S, P j)).Connected

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ci_extra_connected
statement:
theorem ci_extra_connected
    {V : Type u} (p x : ℕ)
    {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (A : MinorModel (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin p × Fin x)) G)
    (M : Fin p → MinorModel
      (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 2 × Fin x)) G) :
    ∀ z j, j ∈ ciExtraIndex p x z →
      (G.induce (ciExtraPiece p x A M z j)).Connected

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ci_nonzero_stage_base_witness
statement:
theorem ci_nonzero_stage_base_witness
    {V : Type u} (p x : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (A : MinorModel (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin p × Fin x)) G)
    (M : Fin p → MinorModel
      (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 2 × Fin x)) G)
    (C : Sum (Fin p × Fin x) (Fin x) → Set V)
    (core : Set V)
    (hOldCore : ∀ z w, z ≠ w →
      ∃ a ∈ A.branch z, ∃ b ∈ A.branch w,
        a ∈ core ∧ b ∈ core ∧ G.Adj a b)
    (hChildCore : ∀ i z, (M i).branch z ⊆ core) :
    ∀ z w : Sum (Fin p × Fin x) (Fin x), z ≠ w →
      ∃ a ∈ branchBase C (ciExtraPiece p x A M) (ciExtraIndex p x) z,
        ∃ b ∈ branchBase C (ciExtraPiece p x A M)
          (ciExtraIndex p x) w,
          a ∈ core ∧ b ∈ core ∧ G.Adj a b

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ciExtraLabel_exists_of_mem
statement:
theorem ciExtraLabel_exists_of_mem
    (p x : ℕ)
    (z : Sum (Fin p × Fin x) (Fin x))
    (slot : Option (Fin p))
    (hslot : slot ∈ ciExtraIndex p x z) :
    ∃ l : ciPrimitiveLabel p x,
      ciExtraLabel p x z slot = some l

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ciExtraPiece_eq_primitive
statement:
theorem ciExtraPiece_eq_primitive {V : Type u} (p x : ℕ)
    {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (A : MinorModel (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin p × Fin x)) G)
    (M : Fin p → MinorModel
      (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 2 × Fin x)) G)
    (z : Sum (Fin p × Fin x) (Fin x))
    (slot : Option (Fin p)) :
    ciExtraPiece p x A M z slot =
      match ciExtraLabel p x z slot with
      | some l => ciPrimitiveSet p x A M l
      | none => ∅

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ciPrimitiveSet_disjoint
statement:
theorem ciPrimitiveSet_disjoint
    {V : Type u} (p x : ℕ)
    {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (A : MinorModel (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin p × Fin x)) G)
    (M : Fin p → MinorModel
      (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 2 × Fin x)) G)
    (hAChild : ∀ i, Disjoint A.vertices (M i).vertices)
    (hChildChild : ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      Disjoint (M i).vertices (M j).vertices) :
    ∀ l m : ciPrimitiveLabel p x, l ≠ m →
      Disjoint (ciPrimitiveSet p x A M l)
        (ciPrimitiveSet p x A M m)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.branchBase_disjoint_of_pieces
statement:
theorem branchBase_disjoint_of_pieces
    {V : Type u} {I : Type v} {J : Type*}
    (C : I → Set V) (E : I → J → Set V)
    (extra : I → Finset J)
    (hCC : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (C i) (C j))
    (hCE : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ a ∈ extra j,
      Disjoint (C i) (E j a))
    (hEE : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∀ a ∈ extra i, ∀ b ∈ extra j,
      Disjoint (E i a) (E j b)) :
    ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      Disjoint (branchBase C E extra i) (branchBase C E extra j)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.extra_meet_of_path_attachment
statement:
theorem extra_meet_of_path_attachment
    {V : Type u} {I : Type v} {J K : Type*}
    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq I]
    (C : I → Set V) (P : K → Set V)
    (owner : K → I)
    (E : I → J → Set V) (extra : I → Finset J)
    (hattach : ∀ i j, j ∈ extra i →
      ∃ k, owner k = i ∧ ∃ v, v ∈ P k ∧ v ∈ E i j) :
    ∀ i j, j ∈ extra i →
      ∃ v, v ∈ C i ∪ assignedPaths owner P i ∧ v ∈ E i j

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.path_base_disjoint_of_pieces
statement:
theorem path_base_disjoint_of_pieces
    {V : Type u} {I : Type v} {J K : Type*}
    (C : I → Set V) (P : K → Set V)
    (E : I → J → Set V) (extra : I → Finset J)
    (owner : K → I)
    (hPC : ∀ k i, owner k ≠ i → Disjoint (P k) (C i))
    (hPE : ∀ k i, owner k ≠ i → ∀ a ∈ extra i,
      Disjoint (P k) (E i a)) :
    ∀ k i, owner k ≠ i →
      Disjoint (P k) (branchBase C E extra i)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.stageState_of_raw_model
statement:
theorem stageState_of_raw_model
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (p x k m coreBound : ℕ)
    (root : Sum (Fin p × Fin x) (Fin x) → V)
    (M : RootedMinorModel
      (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Sum (Fin p × Fin x) (Fin x))) G root)
    (S H : Finset V)
    (hHconnected : VertexConnected (G.induce (H : Set V)) k)
    (hreserve : chromatic G ≤ chromatic (G.induce (H : Set V)) + m)
    (hcore : S.card ≤ coreBound)
    (htangent : ∀ i, M.branch i ∩ (H : Set V) = {root i})
    (hcoreWitness : ∀ i j, i ≠ j →
      ∃ a ∈ M.branch i, ∃ b ∈ M.branch j,
        a ∈ S ∧ b ∈ S ∧ G.Adj a b)
    (hintersection : M.toMinorModel.vertices ∩ (H : Set V) ⊆ (S : Set V)) :
    Nonempty (StageState G ((p + 1) * x) k m coreBound)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ci_extra_piece_meets_assigned_path
statement:
theorem ci_extra_piece_meets_assigned_path
    {V : Type*} (p x : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (oldRoot : Fin p × Fin x → V)
    (A : RootedMinorModel
      (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin p × Fin x)) G oldRoot)
    (childRoot : Fin p → Fin 2 × Fin x → V)
    (M : ∀ i, RootedMinorModel
      (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 2 × Fin x)) G (childRoot i))
    (P : CIPathIndex p x → Set V)
    (hOldPath : ∀ i r,
      oldRoot (i,r) ∈ P (ciOldStartIndex p x i r))
    (hChildOldPath : ∀ i r,
      childRoot i (0,r) ∈ P (ciOldMiddleIndex p x i r))
    (hChildNewPath : ∀ i r,
      childRoot i (1,r) ∈ P (ciNewMiddleIndex p x i r)) :
    ∀ z j, j ∈ ciExtraIndex p x z →
      ∃ k : CIPathIndex p x,
        pathOwner p x k = z ∧
        ∃ v, v ∈ P k ∧
          v ∈ ciExtraPiece p x A.toMinorModel
            (fun i => (M i).toMinorModel) z j

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.rooted_model_path_disjoint_of_other_index
statement:
theorem rooted_model_path_disjoint_of_other_index
    {I : Type u} {K : Type v} {V : Type*}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {root : I → V}
    (M : RootedMinorModel (SimpleGraph.completeGraph I) G root)
    {P : IndexedPairs K V} (L : IndexedLinkage G P)
    (hExact : M.toMinorModel.vertices ∩ L.vertices =
      Set.range root)
    (assigned : I → K)
    (hterm : ∀ i, root i ∈ P.terminals (assigned i))
    (i : I) (k : K) (hki : k ≠ assigned i) :
    Disjoint (M.branch i) (pathVertexSet (L.path k))

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.rooted_model_path_disjoint_of_other_index_single
statement:
theorem rooted_model_path_disjoint_of_other_index_single
    {I : Type u} {K : Type v} {V : Type*}
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {root : I → V}
    (M : RootedMinorModel (SimpleGraph.completeGraph I) G root)
    {P : IndexedPairs K V} (L : IndexedLinkage G P)
    (hExact : M.toMinorModel.vertices ∩ L.vertices =
      Set.range root)
    (i : I) (assigned k : K)
    (hterm : root i ∈ P.terminals assigned)
    (hki : k ≠ assigned) :
    Disjoint (M.branch i) (pathVertexSet (L.path k))

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.rooted_model_path_intersection_subset_root
HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ci_path_disjoint_wrong_extra_piece
statement:
theorem ci_path_disjoint_wrong_extra_piece
    {V : Type*} (p x : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (oldRoot : Fin p × Fin x → V)
    (A : RootedMinorModel
      (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin p × Fin x)) G oldRoot)
    (childRoot : Fin p → Fin 2 × Fin x → V)
    (M : ∀ i, RootedMinorModel
      (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin 2 × Fin x)) G (childRoot i))
    {P : IndexedPairs (CIPathIndex p x) V}
    (L : IndexedLinkage G P)
    (hOldExact : A.toMinorModel.vertices ∩ L.vertices =
      Set.range oldRoot)
    (hChildExact : ∀ i,
      (M i).toMinorModel.vertices ∩ L.vertices =
        Set.range (childRoot i))
    (hOldTerm : ∀ i r,
      oldRoot (i,r) ∈ P.terminals (ciOldStartIndex p x i r))
    (hChildOldTerm : ∀ i r,
      childRoot i (0,r) ∈ P.terminals (ciOldMiddleIndex p x i r))
    (hChildNewTerm : ∀ i r,
      childRoot i (1,r) ∈ P.terminals (ciNewMiddleIndex p x i r)) :
    ∀ k z, pathOwner p x k ≠ z →
      ∀ j ∈ ciExtraIndex p x z,
        Disjoint (pathVertexSet (L.path k))
          (ciExtraPiece p x A.toMinorModel
            (fun i => (M i).toMinorModel) z j)

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ci_assignedPaths_tangent
statement:
theorem ci_assignedPaths_tangent
    {V : Type*} (p x : ℕ)
    (P : CIPathIndex p x → Set V)
    (root : CIRawIndex p x → V) (H : Set V)
    (hFinalPath : ∀ z, root z ∈ P (ciFinalIndex p x z))
    (hRootH : ∀ z, root z ∈ H)
    (hPathClean : ∀ k v, v ∈ P k → v ∈ H →
      v = root (pathOwner p x k)) :
    ∀ z, assignedPaths (pathOwner p x) P z ∩ H = {root z}

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ci_root_mem_assignedPaths
statement:
theorem ci_root_mem_assignedPaths
    {V : Type*} (p x : ℕ)
    (P : CIPathIndex p x → Set V)
    (root : CIRawIndex p x → V)
    (hFinalPath : ∀ z, root z ∈ P (ciFinalIndex p x z)) :
    ∀ z, root z ∈ assignedPaths (pathOwner p x) P z

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.pathOwner_finalIndex
statement:
theorem pathOwner_finalIndex (p x : ℕ)
    (z : CIRawIndex p x) :
    pathOwner p x (ciFinalIndex p x z) = z

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.chromatic_le_piece_and_complement
statement:
theorem chromatic_le_piece_and_complement
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (U : Finset V) :
    chromatic G ≤ chromatic (G.induce (U : Set V)) +
      chromatic (G.induce (Uᶜ : Finset V))

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.exists_disjoint_small_connected_pieces
statement:
theorem exists_disjoint_small_connected_pieces
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (r k N q d : ℕ)
    (hfind : ∀ R : Finset V,
      d < chromatic (G.induce (R : Set V)) →
      ∃ J : Finset V, J ⊆ R ∧ J.card ≤ N ∧
        VertexConnected (G.induce (J : Set V)) k)
    (hlocal : ∀ U : Finset V, U.card ≤ r * N →
      chromatic (G.induce (U : Set V)) ≤ q)
    (hχ : q + d < chromatic G) :
    ∃ J : Fin r → Finset V,
      (∀ i, (J i).card ≤ N ∧
        VertexConnected (G.induce (J i : Set V)) k) ∧
      (Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (J i) (J j))

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ciChildModelReindex_exact
statement:
theorem ciChildModelReindex_exact {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {K : Type*} {P : IndexedPairs K V} (L : IndexedLinkage G P)
    (x : ℕ) (childRoot : Fin 2 × Fin x → V)
    (M : RootedMinorModel
      (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin (2 * x))) G
      (ciChildRootFin x childRoot))
    (hExact : M.toMinorModel.vertices ∩ L.vertices =
      Set.range (ciChildRootFin x childRoot)) :
    (ciChildModelReindex x childRoot M).toMinorModel.vertices ∩
      L.vertices = Set.range childRoot

name: HadwigerLean.Inseparability.ciChildModelReindex_vertices
statement:
theorem ciChildModelReindex_vertices {V : Type u} {G : SimpleGraph V}
    (x : ℕ) (childRoot : Fin 2 × Fin x → V)
    (M : RootedMinorModel
      (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin (2 * x))) G
      (ciChildRootFin x childRoot)) :
    (ciChildModelReindex x childRoot M).toMinorModel.vertices =
      M.toMinorModel.vertices

name: HadwigerLean.IndexedLinkage.exists_rerouted_linkage
statement:
theorem exists_rerouted_linkage
    {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {j : ℕ} {P : IndexedPairs (Fin j) V}
    (L : IndexedLinkage G P) (H : Finset V)
    {Q : IndexedPairs (L.HitIndex H) V} (I : IndexedLinkage G Q)
    (hI : I.vertices ⊆ (H : Set V))
    (hQstart : ∀ k, Q.start k = (L.exterior H k).first)
    (hQfinish : ∀ k, Q.finish k = (L.exterior H k).last) :
    ∃ L' : IndexedLinkage G P,
      ∀ i, pathVertexSet (L'.path i) ⊆ L.rerouteRegion H I i

name: HadwigerLean.IndexedLinkage.exists_rerouted_linkage_controlled
statement:
theorem exists_rerouted_linkage_controlled
    {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {a j : ℕ} {P : IndexedPairs (Fin j) V}
    (L : IndexedLinkage G P) (H : Finset V)
    (root : Fin a → V)
    (M : RootedMinorModel (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin a)) G root)
    {Q : IndexedPairs (L.HitIndex H) V} (I : IndexedLinkage G Q)
    (hM : M.toMinorModel.vertices ⊆ (H : Set V))
    (hI : I.vertices ⊆ (H : Set V))
    (hMI : M.toMinorModel.vertices ∩ I.vertices ⊆
      Set.range root ∩ L.vertices)
    (hQstart : ∀ k, Q.start k = (L.exterior H k).first)
    (hQfinish : ∀ k, Q.finish k = (L.exterior H k).last) :
    ∃ L' : IndexedLinkage G P,
      L'.vertices ⊆ L.vertices ∪ (H : Set V) ∧
      M.toMinorModel.vertices ∩ L'.vertices ⊆
        Set.range root ∩ L.vertices

name: HadwigerLean.IndexedLinkage.innerPairs_disjointTerminals
statement:
theorem innerPairs_disjointTerminals
    {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {j : ℕ} {P : IndexedPairs (Fin j) V}
    (L : IndexedLinkage G P) (H : Finset V) :
    (L.innerPairs H).DisjointTerminals

name: HadwigerLean.IndexedLinkage.innerPairs_terminals_subset_vertices
statement:
theorem innerPairs_terminals_subset_vertices
    {V : Type*} [DecidableEq V]

name: HadwigerLean.Theorem2.finite_loss_recurrence
statement:
theorem finite_loss_recurrence
    (T : ℕ) (n z w : ℕ → ℝ) (N q a δ β : ℝ)
    (hN : 0 ≤ N) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hn0 : n 0 ≤ N)
    (hnstep : ∀ i < T, n (i + 1) ≤ q * n i)
    (hzstep : ∀ i < T, z (i + 1) ≤ z i + δ * N)
    (hwstep : ∀ i < T, w i ≤ a * z i + β * N) :
    n T + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range T, w i ≤
      q ^ T * N + a * (T : ℝ) * z 0 +
        (a * δ * (T : ℝ) ^ 2 + β * (T : ℝ)) * N

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.three_chromatic_pieces_of_separation
statement:
theorem three_chromatic_pieces_of_separation
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (Y : Finset V) (s : ℕ)
    (hsep : ∀ X : Finset V, X ⊆ Y →
      2 * s < chromatic (G.induce (X : Set V)) →
      Bootstrap.ChromaticSeparable (G.induce (X : Set V)) s)
    (hχ : 3 * s < chromatic (G.induce (Y : Set V))) :
    ∃ J : Fin 3 → Finset V,
      (∀ i, J i ⊆ Y) ∧
      (Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (J i) (J j)) ∧
      (∀ i, chromatic (G.induce (Y : Set V)) ≤
        chromatic (G.induce (J i : Set V)) + 2 * s)

    (hHcard : 2 * a ≤ H.card) :
    ∃ (P : IndexedPairs (Fin a × Fin 2) V)
      (L : IndexedLinkage G P),
      (∀ slot, P.start slot ∈ U) ∧
      (∀ slot, P.finish slot ∈ H) ∧
      (∀ slot v, v ∈ pathVertexSet (L.path slot) → v ∉ Z)

statement:
theorem path_disjoint_other_branch
    {q r : Fin (2 * a)} (hqr : q ≠ r) :
    Disjoint (pathVertexSet (F.linkage.path q))
      ((F.childModel (F.child r)).branch (F.slot r))

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.ThreeChildFrame.path_meets_child
statement:
theorem path_meets_child
    (q : Fin (2 * a)) (k : Fin 3) {x : V}
    (hxp : x ∈ pathVertexSet (F.linkage.path q))
    (hxm : x ∈ (F.childModel k).toMinorModel.vertices) :
    ∃ u : Fin c, x = F.childRoot k u ∧
      F.assignment q = (k, u)

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.ThreeChildFrame.piece_connected
statement:
theorem piece_connected (q : Fin (2 * a)) :
    (G.induce (F.piece q)).Connected

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.ThreeChildFrame.piece_disjoint
statement:
theorem piece_disjoint {q r : Fin (2 * a)} (hqr : q ≠ r) :
    Disjoint (F.piece q) (F.piece r)

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.ThreeChildFrame.root_not_mem_piece
statement:
theorem root_not_mem_piece (j : Fin a) (q : Fin (2 * a)) :
    F.root j ∉ F.piece q

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.connector_ne_of_parent_ne
HadwigerLean.Woven.exact_model_intersection_preserved
statement:
theorem exact_model_intersection_preserved
    {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {c j : ℕ}
    {P : IndexedPairs (Fin j) V} {root : Fin c → V}
    (M : RootedMinorModel (SimpleGraph.completeGraph (Fin c)) G root)
    (L L' : IndexedLinkage G P) (A B : Set V)
    (hM : M.toMinorModel.vertices ⊆ A)
    (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (hOld : M.toMinorModel.vertices ∩ L.vertices = Set.range root)
    (hNew : L'.vertices ⊆ L.vertices ∪ B)
    (hterminal : Set.range root ⊆ P.allTerminals) :
    M.toMinorModel.vertices ∩ L'.vertices = Set.range root

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.IndexedLinkage.mapInduce_vertices_subset
statement:
theorem IndexedLinkage.mapInduce_vertices_subset
    {S : Set V} {P : IndexedPairs ι S}
    (L : IndexedLinkage (G.induce S) P) :
    (L.mapInduce).vertices ⊆ S

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.disjointTerminals_of_injective_ends
statement:
theorem disjointTerminals_of_injective_ends
    (P : IndexedPairs ι V)
    (hs : Function.Injective P.start)
    (ht : Function.Injective P.finish)
    (hst : Disjoint (Set.range P.start) (Set.range P.finish)) :
    P.DisjointTerminals

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.connectorParent_first
statement:
@[simp] theorem connectorParent_first {a : ℕ} (i : Fin a) :
    connectorParent (firstConnector i) = i

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.connectorParent_second
statement:
@[simp] theorem connectorParent_second {a : ℕ} (i : Fin a) :
    connectorParent (secondConnector i) = i

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.exists_parent_connector_starts
statement:
theorem exists_parent_connector_starts
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {a : ℕ}
    (root : Fin a → V)
    (hdegree : ∀ i, 4 * a ≤ G.degree (root i)) :
    ∃ start : Fin (2 * a) → V,
      Function.Injective start ∧
      (∀ q i, start q ≠ root i) ∧
      (∀ i, G.Adj (root i) (start (firstConnector i))) ∧
      (∀ i, G.Adj (root i) (start (secondConnector i)))

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.scaleAssignment_different_children
statement:
theorem scaleAssignment_different_children {a c : ℕ}
    (hscale : 2 * a = 3 * c) (hc : 0 < c)
    (i : Fin a) :
    (scaleAssignment hscale (firstConnector i)).1 ≠
      (scaleAssignment hscale (secondConnector i)).1

name: HadwigerLean.Woven.exists_parent_connector_starts_of_connected
statement:
theorem exists_parent_connector_starts_of_connected
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] {a κ : ℕ}
    (root : Fin a → V) (hconn : VertexConnected G κ)
    (hκ : 4 * a ≤ κ) :
    ∃ start : Fin (2 * a) → V,
      Function.Injective start ∧
      (∀ q i, start q ≠ root i) ∧
      (∀ i, G.Adj (root i) (start (firstConnector i))) ∧
      (∀ i, G.Adj (root i) (start (secondConnector i)))
